* Fix countdown auto start by @LTS-FFXIV in https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/pull/1354

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.
plugin_variants.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugin_variants.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

plugin_variants.description:
Get aurally rewarded when you get commended on duties.

plugin_variants.changelog: Fix improperly sized main UI
plugin_variants.description:
Key Features:
- Receive notifications when friends using GoodFriend log in or out.
- Chat messages show how many of your friends are online when you log in.

Developer's Note on Using This Plugin After Patch 7.0:
As of Patch 7.0, some of the data that GoodFriend uses to identify players during login/logout events is now visible to anyone nearby your character in-game (not just your friends or party members). GoodFriend itself will still only show notifications for people you've added to your in-game friends list - however, please use this plugin only if you're comfortable with your login/logout activity being theoretically visible to nearby players (note: GoodFriend never sends data for users who don't have the plugin installed).

If you ever want to stop sending login/logout events, simply disable or uninstall the plugin. The server does not store any data about you.

For added privacy, you can now set a 'group key' in the plugin settings. This allows events to be shared only with people using the same key (for example, everyone in your raid group). When a group key is active, your events are never visible to anyone outside your group no matter what.
plugin_variants.name: GoodFriend
plugin_variants.punchline: Improvements to the in-game friend system, including login and logout notifications for your friends, and more.

raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
_Hey all, your average plugin developer rewriting their entire plugin every few months here with some exciting news.. I've rewritten GoodFriend from scratch!_

**:warning: Please note that upon updating to the new version, your configuration will be completely wiped as it is no longer compatible. You will also be unable to send events or receive events with your friends using the older version.**

## What's changed?

A new modular design has been used when rewriting so that new functionality can be added in the future with less development work. All the existing functionality of the plugin has been re-implemented already so you shouldn't notice anything missing.

Thanks to this new design, you can now toggle each module on/off independently so that you only have the functionality that you actually want to have.

The interface has also been completely redesigned to clearly show each module as well as plugin-wide configuration options. At the very least, I think it looks better (I'm not a UI/UX designer)

### New Modules

- Login State Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list log in or log out with customizable filtering to only catch the notifications you want to see. (As this is the old functionality of the plugin this module has been enabled by default)

- World Change Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list change worlds using the world visit system while logged in with filtering to only see when people visit your own world (Disabled by default, still being improved as of now)

### Bug Fixes

- Too many to list here, but most of the fixes are related to connectivity problems.

Let me know what you think in either the `#plugin-testing` channel or the GoodFriend plugin thread! Thanks in advance to the plugin reviewers that have to review this as well.

[Happy pride month btw](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FxqJcqvXgAE65GU?format=jpg&name=large)

raw_manifest_json.Name: XIVDeck
raw_manifest_json.Punchline: Turn your Elgato Stream Deck into a hotbar!
raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
For a release that should be dedicated to pi, XIVDeck has decided to lose some weight and become quite a bit leaner. Kinda need to do that if you want to start running on phones...

- XIVDeck now properly supports Stream Deck SDK version 6.1, which brings some minor code improvements.
- A bunch of performance improvements to keep XIVDeck feeling snappy.
  - A minor optimization to hotbar monitoring means XIVDeck wastes less of each frame, every frame.
  - Removed an unnecessary cache that just made on-login and other events take slightly longer.
  - Update volume management to listen for events instead of checking every frame for volume changes.
- Update the German and French translations (thank you Alice and Khayle!).
- Adds some useful logging messages on plugin startup to help diagnose certain issues.
- Other miscellaneous fixes.

For those of you who are interested in XIVDeck (or otherwise bringing your hotbars out of the game), but don't want to buy a Stream Deck, I have some cool news. Elgato released a new version of [Stream Deck Mobile for iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/elgato-stream-deck-mobile/id1440014184), which now gives you six virtual buttons free, forever. Android is allegedly going to get this update soon. Possibly. I promise I was not paid to make this statement.

Full release notes, testing notes, and downloads are available [on the plugin GitHub](https://github.com/KazWolfe/XIVDeck/releases/tag/v0.3.14).

plugin_variants.author: darkarchon
plugin_variants.changelog: Update to api 13
plugin_variants.description:
With the release of 7.0 SquareEnix has implemented several temporal antialiasing solutions. However they all have a severe bug that affects image quality significantly.
This plugin will restore using jitter when talking to NPCs or in cutscenes and gpose. Jitter (not noticeable micromovements of the camera) is necessary for temporal antialiasing solutions (DLSS, DLAA, TSCMAA+jitter) to work properly.
For some reason, SquareEnix decided we don't need jitter during the time where the game benefits from using it the most.
plugin_variants.name: XIVJitterFix
plugin_variants.punchline: Fixes SquareEnix' botched antialiasing implementation

plugin_variants.author: Elypha
plugin_variants.changelog:
v1.7.1.0

This is a major update and please check against your current settings after updating, as some settings have been renamed or removed.

- Add support for NPC dialogues.
- Add support for a few more actions/items (DeepDungeon, minions/mounts, Bozjan, etc.).
- Add lookup history window to show some statistics about your bilingual exploration.
- Add support for all FFXIV official languages (JEDF plus Chinese and Korean, WIP).

v1.7.2.0 ~ v1.7.6.0
- Fix NPC dialogue matching issue for alphabetic languages (English, French, German, etc.).
- Fix long tooltips going beyond the screen.
- Gaps before/after the divider line between the translated description and the native one are now configurable in pixels.
- Tooltip layout is computed more accurately for better alignment/less chance to break.
- Fix the issue where the config window still pops up when the NPC dialogue feature is disabled.
plugin_variants.description:
Yes, we have tooltips displayed in two languages now. You paid SE for 4 languages so make very good use of it.

- Interested in localised item descriptions in different languages?
- Got fed up of transliterated カタカナ and would rather read just the original words?

We've got you! See plugin config to customise your own experience.
plugin_variants.name: BilingualTooltips
plugin_variants.punchline: In case the WoL speaks more than one language

plugin_variants.author: tesu
plugin_variants.changelog: API 15
plugin_variants.description:
Plugin for simplifying "pennying" (undercutting current lowest offer by 1).

The usual workflow for this is the following:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Take a mental note of what the current lowest offer is
4. Subtract one from it
5. Close the current listings window
6. Update your item's price with the number you noted
7. Confirm your new price

This plugin eliminates the mental notekeeping steps in the middle by automatically copying the number you want onto your clipboard when you open the current listings window.  

Therefore, your new workflow becomes this:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Close the current listings window
4. Paste the undercut value in
5. Confirm your new price

This both speeds up the process and reduces room for error from typos.
plugin_variants.name: Penny Pincher
plugin_variants.punchline: Copies 1 below the cheapest offer to your clipboard when you check marketboard prices

Fixed `/dice` roll detection

Thanks to Zunetrix on Discord for submitting and sending over an updated sig
plugin_variants.description:
## Modes
### Venue:
- Concise display of all concurrent players in a list-based format
- Supports multiple sorting types (min, max, nearest to)
- Highlight numbers based on regex matching

### DeathRoll:
- Supports multiple players
- Automatic checks to prevent number skipping

### Tournament (1v1 DeathRoll):
- Automatic bracket generation with byes to fill uneven
- Forfeit functionality if a player needs to leave

### Blackjack:
- Automatic reward calculation based on common rules
- Simplistic, or visual view of cards in play
- Automatic or manual player-based draw for cards

### Extra Features:
- Block or prevent players from partaking in any game
- Accept only /random or /dice commands

## Games
### Tic-Tac-Toe
- Play against your friends, or AI
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 3x3, 4x4, 5x5

### Minesweeper
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 8x8, 9x9, 16x16, 18x30
- Custom Games (planned)

More features are planned, following user feedback.
plugin_variants.name: Death Roll Helper
plugin_variants.punchline: Plugin to help with a number of dice games. Also offers games like Tic-Tac-Toe, Minesweeper and Bahamood.

Your character is personal, so you should be able to have NPCs refer to them
the way that you want. With PrefPro, you can control which text option
will appear when an NPC uses dialogue meant for a specific in-game gender.
This allows you to use a female player model and be referred to as male, and
vice versa. In addition, there are a few name customization options - if you
want to only be referred to by your last name, so be it.
Note: This plugin currently will not swap voiced cutscene dialogue.

plugin_variants.changelog: Update for 7.5
plugin_variants.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro' but this command cannot be used while macros are running.

plugin_variants.punchline: Run multiple macros one after the other.

This is a major update and please check against your current settings after updating, as some settings have been renamed or removed.

- Add support for NPC dialogues.
- Add support for a few more actions/items (DeepDungeon, minions/mounts, Bozjan, etc.).
- Add lookup history window to show some statistics about your bilingual exploration.
- Add support for all FFXIV official languages (JEDF plus Chinese and Korean, WIP).

- Fix NPC dialogue matching issue for alphabetic languages (English, French, German, etc.).
- Fix long tooltips going beyond the screen.
- Gaps before/after the divider line between the translated description and the native one are now configurable in pixels.
- Tooltip layout is computed more accurately for better alignment/less chance to break.

plugin_variants.author: Una
plugin_variants.changelog:
# Umbra 3.1.18

## Fixes & Improvements

- Adds setting "Use windows draw list" to Toolbar Settings. By enabling it, other plugins may draw on top of Umbra Toolbars. This adds support for plugins that manage window layers. e.g. Gaolbreak (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Adds setting to auto-hide Auxiliary Toolbars (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Adds placeholders for Free Company name and tag (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Enables Occult Survey Point Markers for North Horn (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Added support for Fortune Carrot markers in North Horn (By [GayPotatoEmma](https://github.com/GayPotatoEmma)).
- Added support for Pot Coffer markers in North Horn (By [GayPotatoEmma](https://github.com/GayPotatoEmma)).
- Overhauled the Phantom Jobs widget with new display options. Users who prefer the old layout can easily swap back to it in the Widget Settings (By [GayPotatoEmma](https://github.com/GayPotatoEmma)).
- Fixes Dynamic Menu placeholders not being updated (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Fixes possible Access Violation while accessing equipments (By [LTS-FFXIV](https://github.com/LTS-FFXIV)).
- Fixes 24h clock displaying another format depending on operating system settings (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Fixes 12h clock displaying leading zero (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Gearset Switcher does now also hide the prefix in the header when configured (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Weather Widget now displays time left for the current weather (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Fix Teleport Widget keeping old housing entries e.g. when world visiting (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).

---

Join [Umbra's Discord server](https://discord.gg/xaEnsuAhmm) for the latest updates and information.
Visit the [website](https://una-xiv.github.io/umbra-docs/) for more information and guides on how to make the most out of Umbra.
plugin_variants.description: Consolidates common UI elements and actions into a single uniform interface in the form of a set of highly customizable toolbars.
plugin_variants.name: Umbra XIV
plugin_variants.punchline: Adds fully customizable toolbars and 3D world markers to the game.

**Fixed**
• Weekly/daily hunt bill mark sensing shows again when “Show mark bill messages” is on (e.g. “You sense your mark to the southwest” / FR “Vous ressentez la présence d’un monstre d’élite au sud-ouest !”). Those lines were being blocked by mistake.

**Added**
• Macro-friendly debug toggle:
  – `/tidy debug` — toggle debug mode
  – `/tidy debug on` / `/tidy debug off` — set it explicitly
  (`/tidychat` accepts the same arguments. With no arguments, `/tidy` still opens settings.)
plugin_variants.description:
Trim the messages FFXIV dumps into your chat log.

  - Master filters for System, Progress, Loot, Obtained, Crafting, and Gathering
  - Toggles for currencies, FC and retainer messages, level-ups, mount unlocks, orchestrion lines, deep dungeon pomanders, combat log categories, and more
  - Shorter rewrites for instance entry, commendations, Novice Network, and treasure dungeon text
  - Copies /say quest dialogue to your clipboard; can block emote spam from others
  - Player whitelist, chat history deduplication, per-tomestone hides, and debug logging

plugin_variants.punchline: Cut down FFXIV chat spam with per-message toggles and shorter system lines.

plugin_variants.description:
(PvE-only.) Adds the /stickyfocustarget command, which focuses your current
target, as long as you do not already have a focus target set.
  
Have you ever felt focusing was under-utilised? Wanted to use it without a
dedicated keybind? Do you not even know what focus targeting is?
You've come to the right place.
  
You can add this command to your Attack Nearest macro and ensure that the
first enemy you target will also become focused, and stay that way, until it dies.
With this, you can focus enemies without having to consciously press a keybind,
and ensure that, for instance, when a focused boss spawns an add and you target it,
the boss' focus will NOT get overriden.

This plugin does not change the behaviour of the stock /focustarget command,
and must be triggered either manually or by adding it to a macro.
Placeholders are supported.
plugin_variants.name: Sticky Focus Target
plugin_variants.punchline: Like /focustarget, but with no overrides.

A clean interface that shows the user's gearsets in a scrollable table, where gearsets can be rearranged by drag and drop. Once the user is happy with the order of their gearsets, they can click apply to change them in game. The sorter has two methods: insert and swap. The mode method can be changed by clicking the button showing the mode.

Also has a window to preview the gearset. Shows the name of the gearsets, item level, items in gearset and attached materia. Once a user selects a gearset it'll show in the preview block, where they can select "Equip" to equip the gearset or "Update" (user must hold Left Ctrl to access) to apply currently equipped gear to the selected gearset.

plugin_variants.author: twelvehouse
plugin_variants.changelog:
New Features:
- Added a marker at the top of the message list to indicate where scrollback history begins.
- Added a pull-to-reconnect gesture on mobile: swipe down from the top of the message list to refresh the connection and reload history.
plugin_variants.description:
Features:
- Real-time chat streaming via Server-Sent Events
- Supports all channel types: FC, LS/CWLS 1-8, Party, Tell, Say, Shout, Yell, Alliance, and more
- Custom filters with drag-and-drop reordering, unread badges, and default send channels
- Tell mode with pin support and recent DM history
- Send queue: brief countdown after pressing Send so you can cancel accidental sends (opt-in)
- Emote picker with search and recently used, and FFXIV symbol picker
- Link previews for trusted sites (Lodestone, YouTube, Twitter/X, Twitch, and more)
- Appearance customisation: Light and Dark themes, Google Fonts, font size, coloured message backgrounds
- Passcode authentication for browser access
plugin_variants.name: ChatAnywhere
plugin_variants.punchline: Host your chat on a web server so you can talk from anywhere.

plugin_variants.changelog:
**Scrollable Tabs** is a lightweight plugin that lets you use the mouse wheel to switch tabs.

The following windows are supported and can be toggled individually:

- Aether Currents
- Armoury Chest
- Blue Magic Spellbook
- Character
- Character -> Classes/Jobs
- Character -> Reputation
- Chocobo Saddlebag
- Companion
- Currency
- Facewear
- Fashion Accessories
- Field Records
- Fish Guide
- Glamour Dresser (scrolls pages, not tabs)
- Gold Saucer -> Card List
- Gold Saucer -> Decks -> Edit Deck
- Gold Saucer -> Lord of Verminion -> Minion Hotbar
- Inventory
- Island Minion Guide
- Minions
- Mounts
- Retainer Inventory
- Shared FATE
- Sightseeing Log

The Command Panel already includes this functionality and instead has an option to disable its tab-scrolling sound effect.

Plugin configuration is available via Plugin Installer.

plugin_variants.author: eja-git
plugin_variants.changelog:
# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.author: Meoiswa
plugin_variants.changelog:
v1.0.2.0:
- Added EchoXIV Translate (LibreTranslate) as a dedicated unlimited translation engine and added Yandex support.
- Expanded local AI support for OpenAI-compatible servers such as LM Studio and Ollama, including model configuration, connection checks, timeout control, disabled thinking mode, and response token limits.
- Added configurable translation-engine fallback with automatic recovery checks for the primary engine.
- Prevented repeated failover loops when local AI returns an empty response or is unavailable.
- Added destination-language context to translation requests and logs so the requested output language is explicit.
- Added single-request AI romanization, returning translated text and romanized text together as structured JSON.
- Updated the translated-chat window to display romanized output while preserving translated and source text according to message direction.
- Applied configuration changes immediately, including language, engine, fallback, and romanization settings.
- Fixed Papago using its current web endpoint and improved translation error handling.

**Initial release of WukLamark to 'testing/live'**
## What's New
- Create and manage custom waymarks that display visibly on both the Main Map and Minimap.
- Highly customizable markers: Use simple shapes (with custom colors) or pick from hundreds of in-game icons.
- Waymark Groups: Organize your waymarks into nested, collapsible categories.
- Waymark/Group Scopes: Designate waymarks and/or groups as "Personal" (locked to your specific character) or "Shared" (visible to all characters that log in on your PC).
- Read-Only Waymarks/Groups (for Shared Waymarks/Groups): Protect shared waymarks and groups as "Read-Only" so you (or someone else) don't accidentally edit or delete them!
- Import/Export: Easy clipboard sharing to distribute groups of waymarks to your friends.

Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words

- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

plugin_variants.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
plugin_variants.name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugin_variants.punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!

plugin_variants.author: Zeffuro, Pie Lover
plugin_variants.changelog:
Adds a fast symbol picker letting you quickly insert any symbols into supported in-game text fields.
It is designed to make commonly used symbols easier to access without manually copying them from third-parties or typing them every time.

## Features
- Adds a floating quick-access "♥" button for opening the symbol popup
  - Allows the "♥" button position to be changed through drag-and-drop repositioning
  - Provides a symbol popup for quickly selecting and inserting symbols
  - List shows ALL existing custom symbols for FFXIV
- Supports opening the symbol popup through a configurable keybind
- Ensures only one symbol popup is open at a time
- Allows keybind-opened popups to be temporarily moved by dragging empty space inside the popup
- Includes a character selector toggle option for symbol selection behavior
- Adds an optional "Close popup on lost focus" setting to auto-close the popup when clicking outside of it
- Adds quick popup controls for closing the popup, changing the "♥" button position and opening the config window
- Includes a help tooltip explaining how to properly use some features

## Notes
The plugin is intended as a lightweight quality-of-life tool for players who frequently use special symbols in chat, search fields, notes or others

raw_manifest_json.Author: ssalazar217 (SteSE)
raw_manifest_json.Description:
EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple engines (Google, Papago, Local AI) with automatic failover to Google.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores (Google, Papago, IA local) con failover automático a Google.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.
raw_manifest_json.Name: EchoXIV
raw_manifest_json.Punchline: Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.

plugin_variants.author: ryankhart
plugin_variants.changelog:
**Shop Item Icons** is a lightweight plugin to display item icons instead of item category icons in shops.

Supported windows:

- **Shops:** Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- **Item Exchange:** Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- **Item Exchange (categorized):** Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- **Currency Exchange:** Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- **Grand Company Seal Exchange:** Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- **Rewards:** Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- **Exchange:** Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.

The plugin has no configuration. It just works.

plugin_variants.author: bwuny
plugin_variants.changelog:
# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.changelog: - Add GetCapturedPositions method
plugin_variants.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
plugin_variants.name: Splatoon
plugin_variants.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

- Play XAT .xcp camera files
- Play/Blend animations of G-Pose actors
- Control Time/Weather in both the Overworld and G-Pose

raw_manifest_json.Author: Minmoose, Asgard and Contributors
raw_manifest_json.Description:
Brio is suite of tools that gives you advanced control to edit and pose actors during G-Pose.

- Advanced actor posing 
	- While animating
	- Adjust actor positions without them resetting
	- Overlay and graphical posing modes
- Creation of up to 239 G-Pose actors
- Creation of custom lights
- Supports integration with Penumbra, Glamourer & Customize+
- Offline import and export of MCDF files onto G-Pose actors
- Play XAT .xcp camera files
- Play/Blend animations of G-Pose actors
- Control Time/Weather in both the Overworld and G-Pose
- Change the active festivals and apply up to 4 at once
- Add/Remove Status Effects of G-Pose actors

plugin_variants.author: Ice
plugin_variants.changelog:
- Removed version checking from fishing side (not really necessary now since it's out of testing, and should allow for dev versions to work w/o it yelling at you)
- Pandora states will now be restored even if a "Stop When" Condition was met
- Updated #1661 Fishing preset
- Added a check for *-if-* an item can be merged. (Was causing some issues with users with high ping)
- Updated preset #1004 of the fishing preset

### Overlay
- Will now only force open once you enter a cosmic territory each time vs constantly making sure it's open...
- Also added a command to open the overlay as well `/ice overlay`
- This also means you can open it outside of the cosmic area if you want to keep track of weather / timed missions while doing other things with your life. Because who sits on the moon (self callout post)
- Added mastery score to the overlay
plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice
plugin_variants.name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugin_variants.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON

plugin_variants.author: XeldarAlz
plugin_variants.changelog: v0.1.2.3: Fix the in-game suggestion highlight after a call. Once you called pon, chi, or kan, the highlight could jump to the wall along the top of the board or land on the wrong tile, because it located your hand by geometry and the shrunken hand let the perfectly-aligned wall slots win. It now anchors to the bottom-most row (your hand is always at the bottom) and ignores melded tiles, so the outline stays on the suggested discard. The hand reading and suggestion were always correct; only the on-tile outline was affected.

It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

plugin_variants.author: Liza Carvelli, a1hena
plugin_variants.changelog:
ec459fc: Update ARControl.csproj
f0ea323: Remove DiscardHelper integration
ea6de7c: Modernize codebase with C# 12 features

- Adopt primary constructors in VentureResolver, AutoRetainerReflection, and VentureListTab
  - Reduces boilerplate code by eliminating field declarations and assignments
  - Parameters are directly accessible throughout the class
- Standardize collection expressions using [] syntax
  - Replace 'new Dictionary<>()' with '[]' for cleaner initialization
  - Replace 'new List<>()' with '[]' for consistency
- Simplify LINQ queries by replacing .Where().Cast<>() with .OfType<>()
  - More efficient and cleaner null filtering
  - Removes unnecessary null-forgiving operators (!)
- Update array initializers to use collection expression syntax

These changes reduce code complexity while maintaining full compatibility with .NET 10 and C# 12.
1138beb: Switch to ECommons DalamudReflector

- Replace custom DalamudReflector implementation with ECommons.Reflection.DalamudReflector
- Simplify AutoRetainerReflection by removing IDisposable pattern (static method usage)
- Delete ARControl/Internal/DalamudReflector.cs (117 lines)
- Update .gitignore to exclude .claude/ directory

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OhKannaDuh/plugins/refs/heads/master/manifest.json
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

- Compressed and deduplicated (read: small) downloads
- Automatic updates (optional)

- Mod changelogs

platform you were using before.

plugin_variants.changelog:
- Removed version checking from fishing side (not really necessary now since it's out of testing, and should allow for dev versions to work w/o it yelling at you)
- Pandora states will now be restored even if a "Stop When" Condition was met
- Updated #1661 Fishing preset
- Added a check for *-if-* an item can be merged. (Was causing some issues with users with high ping)
- Updated preset #1004 of the fishing preset

### Overlay
- Will now only force open once you enter a cosmic territory each time vs constantly making sure it's open...
- Also added a command to open the overlay as well `/ice overlay`
- This also means you can open it outside of the cosmic area if you want to keep track of weather / timed missions while doing other things with your life. Because who sits on the moon (self callout post)
- Added mastery score to the overlay
plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice

plugin_variants.author: Aida Enna
plugin_variants.changelog: - Updated for patch 7.5
plugin_variants.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aida-Enna/XIVPlugins/main/repo.json
plugin_variants.name: Macro Chain Redux
plugin_variants.punchline: A modified fork of the old Macro Chain that allows you to run multiple macros one after the other (or repeat them).

plugin_variants.author: attick, daemitus, alymphocyte, grammernatzi
plugin_variants.changelog:
New features unlikely to be added until Evercold releases. Bug fixes will still happen, though.
    
    1.5.0.91: 
    * Removed Burst Strike/Fated Circle to Bloodfest as you now cannot overcap with Bloodfest.
    * Added Bloodfest to No Mercy.
    * Fixed a bug where Blizzard/Fire switcher did not work without Enochian unlocked.

    1.5.0.90: 
    * Updated to 7.4.
    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP
    
    1.5.0.82:
    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:
    * Phlegma into Eukrasian Dyskrasia added.
    
    1.5.0.73:
    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.
    * Devilment to Starfall Dance feature removed as it is now vanilla.
    * Removed Jump to Mirage Dive due to it being vanilla, as I completely forgot to earlier.
    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.
    
    1.5.0.53:
    * Reaving Steel added from regular XIVComboExpanded. Maybe something else, too? Tis a secret.
    * Hooking Hooksets and Chummy Cast added.
    
    1.5.0.51:
    * Chaotic Glide added.
    
    1.5.0.49:
    * Standard Step into Technical Step added.
    
    1.5.0.41:
    * Viper features added. Please look forward to it (happening right now).

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

plugin_variants.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

## What's Changed
* Fix countdown auto start by @LTS-FFXIV in https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/pull/1354


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/compare/7.5.5.32...7.5.5.33
plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.
plugin_variants.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugin_variants.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

plugin_variants.author: The Redheaded Witch, WillWolf76
plugin_variants.changelog: Fixed some minor bugs.
plugin_variants.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
plugin_variants.name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugin_variants.punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!

plugin_variants.author: Ice
plugin_variants.changelog:
- Removed version checking from fishing side (not really necessary now since it's out of testing, and should allow for dev versions to work w/o it yelling at you)
- Pandora states will now be restored even if a "Stop When" Condition was met
- Updated #1661 Fishing preset
- Added a check for *-if-* an item can be merged. (Was causing some issues with users with high ping)
- Updated preset #1004 of the fishing preset

### Overlay
- Will now only force open once you enter a cosmic territory each time vs constantly making sure it's open...
- Also added a command to open the overlay as well `/ice overlay`
- This also means you can open it outside of the cosmic area if you want to keep track of weather / timed missions while doing other things with your life. Because who sits on the moon (self callout post)
- Added mastery score to the overlay
plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugin_variants.name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugin_variants.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON

plugin_variants.author: Valenth Siveria
plugin_variants.changelog: API15 finally
plugin_variants.description:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool
plugin_variants.name: I Am Ready
plugin_variants.punchline: Automatically accept or decline Duty Finder ready checks based on a configurable counter.

plugin_variants.changelog:
v1.9.0.1

Fixes
- Fixed the formatted Betting amount editor: opening or submitting an entry now affects only that specific row instead of sharing the editor state with other entries.
- Fixed the Rules payout controls so Normal Win, Natural BlackJack, Dirty BlackJack, Charlie, Split, Double Down, and Triple Down each update their own multiplier.
- Fixed payout-on-push handling for Triple Down and completed its dedicated settings, import/export, preset, logging, and Draw Logic integration.

Quality-of-Life Changes

- Added **Imaginary Players (Ghosts)**: Hold CTRL beside a real player's Hold control to add one linked `<FirstName> Ghost`. Ghosts have their own hand, bet, bank, and alias while the real player controls their messages and rolls; all tells and payouts remain routed to the real player. Thanks to **Dissendra Blackthorn@Zodiark** for the idea.
- Added **Ghost Bank Routing**: Regex BankTells now report a real player's bank followed by their imaginary player's bank, route both `/tell`s to the real player, expose `<n>` for the displayed account name, and enforce a 1.1-second queue pause after every tell. The new `transfer <amount|half|50%|min|max>` regex manages funds between both banks, and `withdraw all` / `withdraw everything` pays out both accounts in sequence.
- Added optional **Triple Down** support. It adds a 3× total stake, requires two consecutive cards once chosen, and can be limited by points or disabled after Split. It is disabled by default.
- Added the `TD` main action and the regular `td` / `triple down` message-reaction commands.
- Reorganized the Rules settings hierarchy for clearer BlackJack, Charlie, Split, Double Down, and Triple Down configuration.
- Number steppers with a configured default now reveal an integrated **RESET** action while holding CTRL. Reset mode blocks decrementing; controls without a default retain their normal behavior.
- Standardized the Payout input width to match the Cards field.

plugin_variants.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
plugin_variants.name: Splatoon
plugin_variants.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time

plugin_variants.description: Splatoon is a powerful accessibility tool. It revolutionizes gameplay with its custom waymark system, offering the ability to create unlimited grouped waymarks, labels, and actor indicators with exacting pixel precision. This feature empowers players by making crucial objects and events more visually discernible, thereby facilitating quicker reactions. However, it's important to note that the plugin does not come pre-loaded with presets. Players have the freedom to craft their own or import existing ones, offering a personalized touch to their gaming experience.

plugin_variants.description:
满足您的宇宙探索需求的一站式服务中心! 本插件旨在成为一个综合工具, 让您能够刷取采集与制作职业的宇宙工具, 同时也能帮助您将每个职业的技巧点刷到 50 万, 以获得那台您梦寐以求的的帅气黑色机甲~

- 能够为您反复刷新任务, 直到您想要刷的那个任务出现
- 制作职业在 Artisan 的支持下可以实现完全自动化
- 捕鱼人也能在 AutoHook 和 Navmesh 的支持下实现完全自动化(支持 MissFisher)
- 园艺工/采矿工只需要 Navmesh, 多亏了插件直接内置了采集功能 <3
- 设置您想用宇宙信用点在商店购买的物品, 或使用行星信用点来玩宇宙好运道!

这是一个实验性的本地化分支，可能存在潜在错误需要捉虫
请勿通过闲鱼小店购买此插件，一分钱都不该付

如果无法加载请删除配置文件重新加载
钓鱼任务默认使用 AutoHook 内置预设, 如需使用 MissFisher 请禁用 AutoHook

Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

plugin_variants.changelog: v0.1.2.3: Fix the in-game suggestion highlight after a call. Once you called pon, chi, or kan, the highlight could jump to the wall along the top of the board or land on the wrong tile, because it located your hand by geometry and the shrunken hand let the perfectly-aligned wall slots win. It now anchors to the bottom-most row (your hand is always at the bottom) and ignores melded tiles, so the outline stays on the suggested discard. The hand reading and suggestion were always correct; only the on-tile outline was affected.

It now anchors to the bottom-most row (your hand is always at the bottom) and ignores melded tiles, so the outline stays on the suggested discard. The hand reading and suggestion were always correct; only the on-tile outline was affected.

plugin_variants.author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
plugin_variants.changelog: Two layouts now: portrait and landscape, with an overhauled UI across the plugin - new fonts, resized icons and buttons, and rounded corners throughout. Role slots fall back to sensible defaults when auto-select jobs is off instead of leaving every seat free-for-all, and a preset carries only as many seats as its content actually fields. A new spoiler setting hides and locks duties your character has not unlocked. The PF Analysis button steps aside while the game's own recruitment window is open, FATEs and The Hunt keep recruiting on your own world, and Clears notifies you of each new clear. Fixes: presets no longer save without pressing Save, dungeons are no longer sized as a full party, and Omit removes a role again.
plugin_variants.description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.

plugin_variants.punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.

plugin_variants.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

v1.0.4: Discard All now uses a random 800-1100ms delay between each item (human-paced, ban-safe); Cancel Queue button stops in-progress bulk discard.
v1.0.3: Auto-Discard mode via InventoryManager.DiscardItem.
v1.0.0: Initial release.

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: ThatKwistine
plugin_variants.description: A visual wardrobe for Penumbra mods. Each entry targets a single equipment slot, so you can wear or unwear exactly what you want without disturbing the rest of your look. Handles items spanning several mods, mod option groups, variants, and hair and other customisation mods. Save looks as outfits with per-item dyes, dye a whole outfit at once, and edit an outfit by wearing it and swapping pieces on the character. Import a whole batch of mods at once, or one at a time. Animations, VFX and mounts can be managed alongside your gear if you want them. Also does image previews, tags, favourites, search and sort, and automated screenshot sessions.

plugin_variants.author: Haselnussbomber
plugin_variants.changelog:
- Added: The server info bar entry can not be clicked to open the plugin window.
- Added: The server info bar entry now shows the locations in which you can farm the medals in the tooltip.
- Added: In the table, the medal count of each weapon now also has a tooltip that shows the locations in which you can farm them. A location displayed in a green color is your current location.
- Added: In the table, the minion name can now be clicked to summon it and will be shown in a green color when it is currently summoned.
- Changed: The server info bar entry is now based on the currently summoned minion (previously it was based on inventory changes - the medals that were added) and will persist between zones until the minion is sent away or the weapon has been acquired.

plugin_variants.description: Tracks upgradable gear collections piece by piece. Starts with Occult Crescent: North Horn's Phantom Vision sets - all 7 roles, 5 slots, 4 tiers. Shows which pieces you own and at what tier, what the next upgrade costs, and the exact obol/fixative shortfall to finish a role or the whole collection. plugin_variants.author: Critical_Impact
plugin_variants.description:
Allagan Tool's primary purpose is to keep track of items across your characters/retainers/free company. With it's filter system you'll never lose track of items or not know where they should be sorted.

While this is it's primary purpose, it has quite an exhaustive list of other features including:
	- Craft planning
	- Market board integration
	- Item highlighting in inventories when searching/sorting and picking ingredients for crafts
	- Item window that includes vendor and source information among other things
	- Duty/mob/airship/submarine windows that are fully searchable
	- A filtering system that lets you setup complex searches for specific items 
	- Tooltip integration that'll let you see where the items are on hover
plugin_variants.name: Allagan Tools (KR)
plugin_variants.punchline: Get organized in FFXIV, easily locate/show where to sort items, plan your crafting, and search for mobs, duties, airships, and submarines!

plugin_variants.author: Infi, Anna
plugin_variants.changelog:
**New Feature Added~**
- A web interface has been added
- *This will not function if your game client is offline or you are logged out of the game*

**Main Features**
- View in-game chat on any device that has a web browser functionality
- Can send chat messages through the web interface directly into the game itself
- Easily copy & paste messages
- Option for automatic starting the web interface feature
- Log lines render limit for faster loading performance [Default 1000]

**Security**
- This feature is not intended to be used outside of your local, private network
- Do not forward ports that are described inside the chat2 options panel
- Never share your authentication code under any circumstances
- Multi-box support is not provided, the web interface will track only the first client

**Additional Features soon to be Added**
- Display errors as small notifications inside the web interface

**Planned Features**
- Multiple Tabs support
- Browser specific settings
- Stylization support

**Additional Permissions Note**
- Users that wish to expand this to apps or other platforms are welcome to do so

*Note: An FAQ will be provided in the chat2 thread on the dalamud discord, linked in the About section*

- Screenshot mode (obfuscate names)

plugin_variants.changelog: - Fix config loading issue (Thanks to Caraxi)
plugin_variants.description:
[Important!] Please disable AND uninstall any non-preview version if you'd like to install this version.

This plugin detects certain objects/NPCs such as Aether Currents nearby and shows where they are by various ways, e.g. pointing to their locations on screen and notifying you in Chat.

Currently detects:
	- Aether Currents
	- Mob Hunt Elite Marks
	- Gathering Points
	- [Experimental] Island Sanctuary Gathering Objects and Animals
	- [Experimental] Quest-related NPCs/Objects 

Note: Because most objects/NPCs are not loaded when they are too faraway or when there are too many entities nearby (such as too many player characters), they will not be detected in this case.

Icon by Lumas Arkfrost
 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yomishino/MyDalamudPlugins/main/plugins.json)
plugin_variants.name: Aether Compass [Preview] [Aku API 7]
plugin_variants.punchline: Compasses that detect and mark certain nearby objects/NPCs

plugin_variants.description:
Tired of clicking yes in Praetorium? Can't stand using keys in dungeons? Well do I have the plugin for you! Yes Already is specifically designed to click all the annoying dialogs you've grown accustomed facerolling. Just enter the dialog text, and you'll never see it again! Also works with /regex/ and has several built-in modules for dialogs that aren't quite yes/no prompts but act like it (like desynth).
 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daemitus/MyDalamudPlugins/master/pluginmaster.json)

plugin_variants.author: XeldarAlz
plugin_variants.changelog: v0.1.2.3: Fix the in-game suggestion highlight after a call. Once you called pon, chi, or kan, the highlight could jump to the wall along the top of the board or land on the wrong tile, because it located your hand by geometry and the shrunken hand let the perfectly-aligned wall slots win. It now anchors to the bottom-most row (your hand is always at the bottom) and ignores melded tiles, so the outline stays on the suggested discard. The hand reading and suggestion were always correct; only the on-tile outline was affected.

plugin_variants.description:
Brio is suite of tools that gives you advanced control to edit and pose actors during G-Pose.

- Advanced actor posing 
	- While animating
	- Adjust actor positions without them resetting
	- Overlay and graphical posing modes
- Creation of up to 239 G-Pose actors
- Creation of custom lights
- Supports integration with Penumbra, Glamourer & Customize+
- Offline import and export of MCDF files onto G-Pose actors
- Play XAT .xcp camera files
- Play/Blend animations of G-Pose actors
- Control Time/Weather in both the Overworld and G-Pose
- Change the active festivals and apply up to 4 at once
- Add/Remove Status Effects of G-Pose actors

plugin_variants.author: Critical_Impact
plugin_variants.description:
Allagan Tool's primary purpose is to keep track of items across your characters/retainers/free company. With it's filter system you'll never lose track of items or not know where they should be sorted.

While this is it's primary purpose, it has quite an exhaustive list of other features including:
	- Craft planning
	- Market board integration
	- Item highlighting in inventories when searching/sorting and picking ingredients for crafts
	- Item window that includes vendor and source information among other things
	- Duty/mob/airship/submarine windows that are fully searchable
	- A filtering system that lets you setup complex searches for specific items 
	- Tooltip integration that'll let you see where the items are on hover
plugin_variants.name: Allagan Tools (KR)
plugin_variants.punchline: Get organized in FFXIV, easily locate/show where to sort items, plan your crafting, and search for mobs, duties, airships, and submarines!

plugin_variants.author: doomzao
plugin_variants.description:
Measures your true FFXIV ping by timing the game's own keepalive round-trip (the latency the server actually answers), not the OS network latency. Because it reads the game protocol, it reports the real latency you feel even when you route through a proxy or VPN, where ordinary ping tools only see localhost. Shows current ping, average, min, max, jitter and packet loss, in a floating overlay and in the server info bar.

Commands:
/trueping : open the settings window
/trueping overlay : toggle the floating overlay
/trueping dtr : toggle the server info bar entry
/trueping reset : clear the statistics
plugin_variants.name: True Ping
plugin_variants.punchline: Your real FFXIV ping: the latency you actually feel, with jitter and loss.

plugin_variants.description:

Penumbra. It enables efficient downloads and fast installs to let you get back
to the fun part of mods: using them.

Heliosphere supports:
- Direct install to Penumbra
- Compressed and deduplicated (read: small) downloads
- Automatic updates (optional)
- Version history
- Mod changelogs
- Pictures in Penumbra
- And more

Give Heliosphere a try, and see if you can't say goodbye to any old mod
platform you were using before.

	- While animating
	- Adjust actor positions without them resetting
	- Overlay and graphical posing modes

- Creation of custom lights
- Supports integration with Penumbra, Glamourer & Customize+
- Offline import and export of MCDF files onto G-Pose actors
- Play XAT .xcp camera files
- Play/Blend animations of G-Pose actors
- Control Time/Weather in both the Overworld and G-Pose
- Change the active festivals and apply up to 4 at once
- Add/Remove Status Effects of G-Pose actors

- Updated preset #1004 of the fishing preset

### Overlay
- Will now only force open once you enter a cosmic territory each time vs constantly making sure it's open...
- Also added a command to open the overlay as well `/ice overlay`
- This also means you can open it outside of the cosmic area if you want to keep track of weather / timed missions while doing other things with your life. Because who sits on the moon (self callout post)
- Added mastery score to the overlay

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!

plugin_variants.changelog: - Updated for patch 7.5
plugin_variants.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro
plugin_variants.name: Macro Chain Redux
plugin_variants.punchline: A modified fork of the old Macro Chain that allows you to run multiple macros one after the other (or repeat them).

plugin_variants.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
plugin_variants.name: Splatoon

plugin_variants.author: jkleinne
plugin_variants.description:
Personal fork of RotationSolverReborn that adds PvPSmart, a scoring-based PvP target selector. PvE behavior matches upstream.

The stock PvP cycle ranks targets by absolute current HP, which biases toward tanks over genuinely vulnerable squishies. PvPSmart composes weighted factors (role value, effective HP, finish-kill bias, mitigation penalty, distance, hysteresis, crystal carrier, LB cast, isolation, threat) and skips invuln targets entirely, producing more focus-fire-friendly target selection in Crystalline Conflict.

Use only if you specifically want the PvPSmart targeting mode. For general use, install upstream RotationSolverReborn instead.
plugin_variants.name: Ascended Rotation Solver Reborn
plugin_variants.punchline: PvPSmart target selection on top of RotationSolverReborn.

plugin_variants.author: Bancho
plugin_variants.changelog: A performance patch. Recording nearby players no longer hitches when you zone into a crowd: the proximity log does its bookkeeping once per scan instead of once per player, and world and job names are cached rather than re-read every frame — the difference grows with the size of your recorded log. Opening several profiles in a row now paces its Lodestone requests, so a burst no longer trips the site's rate limiter and fails the lookups. No behaviour changes.

plugin_variants.changelog:
v0.1.0.13 - 2026-08-25
- **`PvPHighestPressure` targeting mode** (issue #4, requested by @Petra105). Selects the hostile the most members of your own side are currently targeting, breaking ties toward the lowest HP percentage. Party and alliance lists are both counted, so it behaves in Frontline (where the rest of your side arrives as alliance members) as well as in Crystalline Conflict. Your own current target is excluded from the count, otherwise the mode would reinforce whatever you were already on. Appended to the end of `TargetingType`, so existing saved `TargetingTypes` indices are unaffected, and it is **not** added to the default list - it is opt-in from Target settings. (`PvPSolver.Basic/Data/TargetType.cs`, `PvPSolver.Basic/Actions/ActionTargetInfo.cs`)

- **Auto-target abandoned an enemy mid damage-window** (issue #4, same report). `FindHostileRaw` re-ranked every hostile from scratch on each action and returned the top of the list, with no reference to the target already selected; `RSCommands.DoAction` then hard-assigned `Svc.Targets.Target` to it. Under an HP-based targeting mode this flips target the instant another enemy's HP crosses yours, so a just-applied Wildfire is left on someone you have stopped hitting. `FindHostileRaw` now consults `FindStickyTarget` before returning: if the current target is still a legal candidate **for the action being used** and carries at least one status sourced from the player with `0 < RemainingTime <= StickyTargetMaxRemaining`, it is kept. (`PvPSolver.Basic/Actions/ActionTargetInfo.cs`)

- Two new options under Target settings: **`StickyTarget`** (default **on**) and **`StickyTargetMaxRemaining`** (default 30s). The second exists so an effectively permanent aura cannot pin the target forever - `RemainingTime == 0` is this codebase's convention for a permanent status and is already excluded, and the cap covers long ones.

- **Trade-off, by design:** while your debuff is ticking the rotation will stay on that target even if another enemy drops lower. That is the requested behavior, and turning `StickyTarget` off restores the previous snap-to-lowest-HP handling exactly.
- **Scoped to PvP.** `FindStickyTarget` returns early unless `DataCenter.IsPvP`, so PvE target selection is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- Sticky selection reads `Svc.Targets.Target`, i.e. the target the previous action settled on, which is what makes this hysteresis rather than a second independent pick.
- `CountTeamPressure` scores every candidate once before sorting rather than inside the comparator; a comparator that re-reads live target data can throw `IComparer.Compare() returns inconsistent results` if a teammate switches target mid-sort.
- **Not yet verified in-game** - shipped to the testing channel only.

v0.1.0.12 - 2026-08-06
- Synced upstream RotationSolverReborn `35ceb6e82` ("Guard status check for Doom to ensure valid object"): the PvP-rotation portion of that commit is a `GameVersion` attribute bump from `7.5` to `7.55` across all 21 PvP rotations.

- **No gameplay change.** The Doom guard itself lives in `RotationSolver.Basic/Helpers/StatusHelper.cs` and upstream's PvE rotations - base classes this fork intentionally does not track (RUNBOOK 3.2). The fork's PvP rotations contain no Doom status checks, so there is nothing to port.
- Synced via `tools/sync-upstream-rotations.sh`; all 21 PvP rotation files verified byte-identical to upstream `6c064f910` (CR-normalised).
- **Promoted to production 2026-08-09.** `AssemblyVersion` 0.1.0.9 -> 0.1.0.12; both channels now ship this build. In-game gate waived by Joey: the 0.1.0.11 fix executes only outside PvP (guard on `DataCenter.IsPvP`) and this sync is attribute-only, so PvP play cannot exercise what changed; the user-facing check is the absence of the PvE `no rotation found` warning in `dalamud.log` (issue #3).

v0.1.0.11 - 2026-08-03
- **Per-frame log spam in all PvE content** (issue #3, reported by @TheWalkingDude19). `UpdateCustomRotation` is driven from the framework tick via `MajorUpdater.RSRRotationAndStateUpdate`, and emitted `WRN ... no rotation found for job=<job> combatType=PvE` roughly 50 times per second for as long as the player was outside PvP. PvPSolver is PvP-only and ships no PvE rotations, so the lookup could never succeed; worse, the miss path set `DataCenter.CurrentRotation = null` immediately before logging, which permanently defeated the unchanged-state guard at the top of the method and forced a full re-resolve every tick. (Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs)

- `UpdateCustomRotation` now returns early when `DataCenter.IsPvP` is false, clearing `CurrentRotation`/`CurrentRotationActions` once on the PvP-to-PvE transition instead of every frame. `curCombatType` is consequently always `CombatType.PvP` below that guard.
- Removed the ungated `PluginLog.Information($"UpdateCustomRotation: job=..., IsPvP=..., groups=...")` call. It ran unconditionally on every invocation, ahead of every early return - invisible to users filtering at Warning+, but hammering `dalamud.log` in PvP and PvE alike.
- Both remaining "no rotation" warnings (`no rotation found for job=...` and `No valid rotations found for ...`) are now throttled by a `_lastNoRotationLogged` (job, combat type) tuple, so a persistent miss reports once rather than once per frame. Reset in `ChangeRotation` so a later successful load re-arms the warning.

- **Shipped to production with 0.1.0.12 (2026-08-09).** In-game gate waived by Joey: every changed statement executes only when `DataCenter.IsPvP` is false, so in-PvP behavior is provably unchanged; the empirical check is that the PvE `no rotation found` warning stops firing (issue #3).
- Both log lines date to the initial vendored commit `9b3652dae`, so this affected every release to date.
- No rotation, targeting or combat behavior changes - the end state in PvE is identical (`CurrentRotation == null`), it is just no longer recomputed and re-logged every tick.

v0.1.0.10 - 2026-07-31
- Synced upstream RotationSolverReborn commit `2ac940563`: the `EmergencyGCD` hook now takes the queued next GCD as a parameter, bringing it in line with `EmergencyAbility`, interrupts, dispels and the heal hooks, which have all taken it for some time. Applied to the base engine (`PvPSolver.Basic/Rotations/CustomRotation_GCD.cs` declaration + both call sites, `PvPSolver.Basic/Rotations/Duties/DutyRotation.cs` declaration) and to the two rotations that override it (`RebornRotations/PVPRotations/Healer/WHM_Default.PVP.cs`, `RebornRotations/PVPRotations/Ranged/BRD_Default.PVP.cs`).

- **No gameplay change.** The new `nextGCD` parameter is not read by any implementation of the hook — not in this fork, and not anywhere in upstream `641bd792e`. It is plumbing for future upstream use. Purify (stun / heavy / bind / silence / deep freeze / Miracle of Nature), Guard, Recuperate and Standard-issue Elixir priority are unchanged, as are the WHM Aquaveil and BRD The Warden's Paean cleanse paths.
- `WHM_Default.PVP.cs` and `BRD_Default.PVP.cs` are now byte-identical to upstream `641bd792e` (verified by diff, CR-normalised).
- First release on the **reinstated testing channel**. The channel was removed 2026-06-07; its previous entry never worked because `TestingDalamudApiLevel` was unset, so Dalamud hid the build. Now set to 15 alongside `TestingAssemblyVersion`. Production remains 0.1.0.9 until this build is verified in-game.
- Escalated by the nightly upstream-merge on 2026-07-31 under RUNBOOK 3.2 ("never pull base classes"). RUNBOOK amended the same day with a signature-only carve-out so equivalent changes sync unattended.

v0.1.0.9 - 2026-07-02
- Hidden the three PvE-only config tabs inherited from upstream: Duty Rotation, Duty, and AutoDuty (incl. the AutoDuty helper-plugin installer list). Tabs are `[TabSkip]`-hidden, not deleted, so nightly subtree merges stay clean. (UI/RotationConfigWindowTab.cs)
- Removed upstream Combat Reborn donation/community links: Ko-fi title-bar button, About-tab Ko-fi button and Discord banner, and the "Thanks to Supporters" About section with its random supporter shout-out hints. (UI/RotationConfigWindow.cs)
- Easter egg window retitled "PvP Solver Lab" (was "RSR Lab"). (UI/EasterEggWindow.cs)

- Part of the 2026-07-02 fork-branding cleanup pass across lalalazy forks. No rotation/behavior changes.
- The Actions-tab "Intercepted" option is PvE-only by nature and remains visible; candidate for a later pass.

v0.1.0.8 - 2026-06-18
- Skip loading PvE duty rotations (Bozja, Emanation, MonsterHunter, Orbonne, Phantom, Variant) entirely. PvPSolver is PvP-only, so the duty rotation set had zero relevance; not loading it reduces memory use and startup time. (Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs)
