plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: attick, daemitus, alymphocyte, grammernatzi
plugin_variants.changelog:
New features unlikely to be added until Evercold releases. Bug fixes will still happen, though.
    
    1.5.0.91: 
    * Removed Burst Strike/Fated Circle to Bloodfest as you now cannot overcap with Bloodfest.
    * Added Bloodfest to No Mercy.
    * Fixed a bug where Blizzard/Fire switcher did not work without Enochian unlocked.

    1.5.0.90: 
    * Updated to 7.4.
    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP
    
    1.5.0.82:
    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:
    * Phlegma into Eukrasian Dyskrasia added.
    
    1.5.0.73:
    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.
    * Devilment to Starfall Dance feature removed as it is now vanilla.
    * Removed Jump to Mirage Dive due to it being vanilla, as I completely forgot to earlier.
    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.
    
    1.5.0.53:
    * Reaving Steel added from regular XIVComboExpanded. Maybe something else, too? Tis a secret.
    * Hooking Hooksets and Chummy Cast added.
    
    1.5.0.51:
    * Chaotic Glide added.
    
    1.5.0.49:
    * Standard Step into Technical Step added.
    
    1.5.0.41:
    * Viper features added. Please look forward to it (happening right now).
plugin_variants.description:
This is an enhanced version of XIVCombo with a variety of new added features.
This is mutually exclusive with other XIVCombo versions, so make sure they do not conflict!
plugin_variants.name: XIV Combo Expandedest
plugin_variants.punchline: Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button. Plus extras.

plugin_variants.author: Dalagab Group
plugin_variants.changelog: Preserve downloaded Sigmascope/security projections when Dalamud official runtime manifests replace the same source/version in the live marketplace view. Apply the same exact-source/version security merge to manually refreshed repository overlays so live manifests keep current install/update metadata without erasing server-side findings. Clear inherited security before every overlay re-evaluation and refuse cross-version or cross-source inheritance, preventing stale scan results from attaching to a different package. Normalize repository-reported download/install totals into a catalog-relative popularity index where 1.00× equals total reported downloads divided by logical plugin count. Show the daily catalog average in Discover, expose `x.xx× catalog average` on product pages, and label the existing download ordering as Popularity. Preserve Dalamud update result statuses instead of flattening `FailedDownload`/`FailedUnload`/`FailedLoad` into a generic exception. Keep failed update state attached to the affected plugin for the current Omega session, show a clear warning in Updates and on the product page, and turn the action into Retry update until it succeeds or is no longer applicable. Explain that `FailedDownload` leaves the installed version unchanged and surface the repository/status details without pretending Omega can see the HTTP exception that Dalamud internally consumed. Move the online marketplace publication contract to descriptor v2 (`omega.catalog.marketplace.v2`) with `cat-v2-*` revisions while retaining read compatibility with legacy v1 descriptors and local SQLite databases. Add a clear-X control and lighter grey background to the global search field. Show aggregate reported downloads/installations in Discover and per-plugin reported downloads/installat…

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

raw_manifest_json.Author: Faye, Kage
raw_manifest_json.Description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

- 切换节庆活动，最多可同时应用 4 项
- 为集体动作角色添加/移除状态效果
- 世界物体生成、动画时间轴与更多功能

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

raw_manifest_json.Description:
Announces the region, zone, area and sub-area you walk into with a styled, animated on-screen notification. It can announce weather changes too, and redraw the game's own banners — Quest Accepted, Duty Commenced, Level Up! — in the same style.

Every line takes its own colours, outline, drop shadow and font — one of the game's own faces, or any font file on your PC.

Inspired by Nekres' "Regions of Tyria" for Guild Wars 2.

Open settings with /regions.
raw_manifest_json.Name: Regions of XIV
raw_manifest_json.Punchline: A beautiful area notification as you walk in and out of zones.

plugin_variants.author: Akari
plugin_variants.description:
Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with three tabs:

UNDERCUT — Stand near a summoning bell and press Run. It walks every retainer on the bell and undercuts each listed item to the lowest price. HQ/NQ handling, own-retainer protection, per-item overrides, and price memory within a run. Skips mannequin/display items (detected by the game's mannequin icon) so they're never touched or delisted.

LISTER — Build a list of items (hold CTRL and hover to quick-add, or search). Press Go and it walks the bell and lists them all, pricing each at the most common market price (ignoring lone troll/outlier listings) minus your undercut. Prices against your world, data center, or whole region. Handles the 20-item-per-retainer cap by rolling extra items to the next retainer. Includes a no-touch dry-run preview.

FLIPPER — Search any marketable item and compare prices across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modeling.

BUYER — Build a shopping list with a per-item quantity and a hard max price. Import a MakePlace furniture list or build a list by hand, choose your scope — my world, my data center, my whole region, or a custom set of data centers — and press SCAN to sweep it via Universalis and see, per item, where the cheapest listings are and how many are available under your cap. Press SEND and it hops world to world with Lifestream, opens a market board, and buys everything at or under your price. Dry run is on by default so you can prove the route without spending a gil, and every purchase is verified against the game's own confirmation dialog before it's accepted.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.

plugin_variants.changelog: 0.1.0.0 — Initial release.
plugin_variants.description: Cross-retainer market workbench with a plan-then-apply flow. Reprice tab: per-retainer 'lowest -N g' / 'lowest exact' buttons walk each listing, fetch live market data via Dalamud's IMarketBoard.OfferingsReceived (skipping your own retainers, deduplicated per item/HQ), stage every change in a queue, then commit them all via a single Apply that calls SetRetainerMarketPrice directly. New listing tab: per-row qty x slots, target retainer combo, auto stack-splitting (e.g. 990 / 99 → ten listings of 99), and direct listing from character bag / Chocobo Saddlebag with no entrust step (saddle items are bulk-staged to the bag in one phase, then listed). Live progress dialog shows the current step (selecting retainer, fetching market data, listing, …) so long runs don't look frozen. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO). Warns once at startup if AutoRetainer is also loaded since both drive retainer summoning.

plugin_variants.punchline: Bulk reprice and split-list retainer market listings across all retainers.

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.

It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: Ice
plugin_variants.changelog:
- Made it to where if you leave the cosmic area, it should auto-close the window
- Missions will now auto-select based on your current level for all classes (this was mainly a problem for sinus with dual class missions...)
    - This might still be a problem with re-rolling... though I'm not sure if I can fix this issue as easily. Go level your gatherers
- Dual class missions will also no longer bug out if you swap to a gathering class while trying to queue as a crafter class (woops)
- Added some more logging for sanity checks in the future
- Spiritbond will now check to make sure you ACTUALLY UNLOCKED IT (aka done the quest) before attempting to do so and getting itself stuck step-moon.
plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice
plugin_variants.name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugin_variants.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON

## Version 2.1.0.2

- Fixed a crash caused by venue entries with missing Data Center data.
- Added support for API-provided custom location overrides.
- Override locations now display their address correctly.
- Prevented Lifestream travel commands from being generated for non-travelable override locations.
plugin_variants.description:
Discover active FFXIV venues with data powered by the FFXIV Venues API. Browse currently open and upcoming venues in a sortable table featuring color-coded data centers, opening times, and a visual timeline. Filter by region, search by name, and adjust the lookahead window to find venues opening soon.

Save favorites, blacklist venues, and add your own custom venues with custom schedules and tags. Lifestream integration lets you teleport directly to any venue, while a compact popout window gives you a quick overview at a glance.

Use /avf to open.
plugin_variants.name: Active Venue Finder
plugin_variants.punchline: Browse FFXIV venues and teleport to them with one click.

plugin_variants.author: Valenth Siveria
plugin_variants.changelog: API15 finally
plugin_variants.description:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool
plugin_variants.name: I Am Ready
plugin_variants.punchline: Automatically accept or decline Duty Finder ready checks based on a configurable counter.

plugin_variants.changelog:
- Removed version checking from fishing side (not really necessary now since it's out of testing, and should allow for dev versions to work w/o it yelling at you)
- Pandora states will now be restored even if a "Stop When" Condition was met
- Updated #1661 Fishing preset
- Added a check for *-if-* an item can be merged. (Was causing some issues with users with high ping)
- Updated preset #1004 of the fishing preset

### Overlay
- Will now only force open once you enter a cosmic territory each time vs constantly making sure it's open...
- Also added a command to open the overlay as well `/ice overlay`
- This also means you can open it outside of the cosmic area if you want to keep track of weather / timed missions while doing other things with your life. Because who sits on the moon (self callout post)
- Added mastery score to the overlay
plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugin_variants.name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugin_variants.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.changelog: - Add GetCapturedPositions method
plugin_variants.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
plugin_variants.name: Splatoon
plugin_variants.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time

plugin_variants.author: attick, daemitus, alymphocyte, grammernatzi
plugin_variants.changelog:
New features unlikely to be added until Evercold releases. Bug fixes will still happen, though.
    
    1.5.0.91: 
    * Removed Burst Strike/Fated Circle to Bloodfest as you now cannot overcap with Bloodfest.
    * Added Bloodfest to No Mercy.
    * Fixed a bug where Blizzard/Fire switcher did not work without Enochian unlocked.

    1.5.0.90: 
    * Updated to 7.4.
    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP
    
    1.5.0.82:
    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:
    * Phlegma into Eukrasian Dyskrasia added.
    
    1.5.0.73:
    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.
    * Devilment to Starfall Dance feature removed as it is now vanilla.
    * Removed Jump to Mirage Dive due to it being vanilla, as I completely forgot to earlier.
    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.
    
    1.5.0.53:
    * Reaving Steel added from regular XIVComboExpanded. Maybe something else, too? Tis a secret.
    * Hooking Hooksets and Chummy Cast added.
    
    1.5.0.51:
    * Chaotic Glide added.
    
    1.5.0.49:
    * Standard Step into Technical Step added.
    
    1.5.0.41:
    * Viper features added. Please look forward to it (happening right now).
plugin_variants.description:
This is an enhanced version of XIVCombo with a variety of new added features.
This is mutually exclusive with other XIVCombo versions, so make sure they do not conflict!
plugin_variants.name: XIV Combo Expandedest
plugin_variants.punchline: Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button. Plus extras.

plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm

plugin_variants.author: XivHub
plugin_variants.description:
Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Every run is previewed item by item with the reason for each decision, and nothing moves until you confirm.

Also does the reverse (pulling gearset pieces back into the armoury) and offers a discard picker: an icon grid of leftover gear, framed by rarity, where anything equipped, in a gearset, or on your allowlist is never listed.
plugin_variants.name: InventoryCleaner
plugin_variants.punchline: Keep only the gear you actually use.

plugin_variants.author: yocopk
plugin_variants.description:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

An all-in-one home for quality-of-life tools that link FINAL FANTASY XIV to your MogHouse account. Tools are added over time; each one can be switched on or off individually, and nothing leaves the game unless you enable it.

Timers: reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U), including submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, custom deliveries and allied society dailies, and syncs them to your profile. MogHouse then pushes you a notification the moment one comes up, on web and mobile, even while the game and your PC are off. Voyages are timed to the last vessel back, so one notification means the whole fleet is home.

Duty Finder: when the confirm window appears, MogHouse pushes the duty or roulette name to your phone, so you know whether it is worth the sprint back to the desk. By default it stays quiet while the game is the window you are looking at.

The plugin is read-only: it collects your own data and reports status. It never performs an in-game action — it will not commence a duty for you, and it does not skip, confirm or automate anything.

Open it with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account, and a free one is enough: it syncs one character and sends one timer alert of your choosing, plus duty pops. Mog+ lifts both limits and warns you before a timer lands rather than as it does.
plugin_variants.name: MogHouse Companion
plugin_variants.punchline: Quality-of-life tools that connect your game to MogHouse. Timers and duty pops, pushed to your phone.

plugin_variants.author: nxships
plugin_variants.description:
Track players you meet in FFXIV — who they are, when you ran into them, how their characters change over time. A focused social tracker built on the NexusKit framework.

Per-player detail view with Summary, Equipment, Class/Jobs, Achievements, Free Company, Encounters, History and Notes tabs. Optional enrichment from Lodestone (gear, FC link, achievement progress) and FFXIVCollect (mounts, minions, full achievement catalog). Live throttled refresh queue keeps external data fresh without hammering either service.

Configurable chat and toast notifications when players you've seen before change — rename, server transfer, Free Company join/leave/switch, achievement growth, refresh failures. Per-event filtering and history grouping so the chat doesn't drown you.

Powerful player-filter language with live preview to slice your list however you want; encounter history scoped per duty and content type; optional bridges to other Dalamud plugins (Lifestream world-travel, more to come).

Local-first: all data lives in a single SQLite file under your XIVLauncher config. Automated weekly maintenance keeps it tidy. English and German localization.
plugin_variants.name: PlayerNexusTracker
plugin_variants.punchline: Track every adventurer you meet in Eorzea.

Features:
• Whole-word matching (so "tank" won't mangle "thanks")
• Case-insensitive by default
• Per-rule enable/disable
• Live preview so you can test rules before using them

Commands:

/shark config — open settings

plugin_variants.changelog:
Added a Web Listen Link - broadcasting hosts can generate a public link so anyone can tune into a live show right in their browser, no EchoMix required.
Added /emix - jumps straight to the DJ Deck view, no matter what's currently on screen, the same way /el already does for the Listener view.
EchoMix no longer opens or draws its window at the title screen or character select - it appears again once actually logged into a character, matching the rest of the Echo plugin suite.
Genres now capitalize every word instead of just the first one, so "heavy metal" displays as "Heavy Metal" - applies to genres already saved on an existing profile too, not just newly-typed ones.

plugin_variants.author: jFray
plugin_variants.changelog:
Bring your Glamourer designs across. Copy one in Glamourer, then press Paste Design in the Outfits pane.
Copy Design puts what you are wearing on the clipboard, ready to paste into Glamourer.
An imported outfit dresses you from bare, so the slots the design leaves empty are emptied rather than left as they were.
A design that hides your headgear or your weapon is imported hidden too.
Glasses, advanced dyes and Penumbra settings cannot come across. EchoGlam tells you what a design was carrying before you save it.
Hide now works both ways. Press it again to put back whatever was in the slot.
plugin_variants.description: Dress your character in any item in the game from a searchable in-game wardrobe, dye every slot, edit full appearance and save named outfits. Then publish the look to a community catalogue you can browse, filter, vote on and favourite without leaving the game - and put anyone else's glamour on with one click, with a revert that is always one click away. No other plugins required.
plugin_variants.name: EchoGlam
plugin_variants.punchline: Build a glamour, share it, and wear anyone else's.

plugin_variants.author: Xorus
plugin_variants.description:
Finally, display all the numbers when starting a countdown!
Comes with an accurate pull timer that starts when you or any of your party members enter combat.

Features :
- Big countdown that displays all the numbers
- Customizable big-number textures (default, yellow, WoW style or custom files)
- Display combat time in the Server Info Bar, and/or a floating window
- OBS browser-source compatible page with countdown and current combat duration

Why the OBS thing ? Well, it can be useful if you want a big stylized stopwatch in your recordings.
See repository for more info.

Feel free so send me feedback, bugs and potential improvements!
plugin_variants.name: EngageTimer
plugin_variants.punchline: Complete combat countdown, pull timer and OBS overlay

plugin_variants.author: tesu
plugin_variants.changelog: Added new option to undercut by multiples. Config menu has been cleaned up.
plugin_variants.description:
Plugin for simplifying "pennying" (undercutting current lowest offer by 1).

The usual workflow for this is the following:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Take a mental note of what the current lowest offer is
4. Subtract one from it
5. Close the current listings window
6. Update your item's price with the number you noted
7. Confirm your new price

This plugin eliminates the mental notekeeping steps in the middle by automatically copying the number you want onto your clipboard when you open the current listings window.  

Therefore, your new workflow becomes this:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Close the current listings window
4. Paste the undercut value in
5. Confirm your new price

This both speeds up the process and reduces room for error from typos.
plugin_variants.name: Penny Pincher
plugin_variants.punchline: Copies 1 below the cheapest offer to your clipboard when you check marketboard prices

plugin_variants.author: Nadya
plugin_variants.description:
It is highly recommended to edit the default settings as you may disagree on which messages should be considered "spam"!

Provides granular filter options to filter nearly all game-related spam, leaving only important game messages in your chat.

  - Filters most spammy game messages
  - Blocks emote spam from other players
  - Condenses earned commendations into a single line
  - Shortens lengthy messages such as joining Novice Network or entering an instanced zone
  - Blocks repeated messages from appearing for a period of time
  - Automatically copies most 'with your chat mode in /say' quest dialogue to your clipboard
  - Write custom filters to Allow/Block messages!
  - And more!
plugin_variants.name: Tidy Chat
plugin_variants.punchline: Better game messages and in-depth chat filters to keep a tidy chat.

plugin_variants.description:
Contributes and utilizes crowdsourced login queue information for the benefit of everyone.

Current features include queue notifications via Discord, so you can know when you make it into the game, as
well as anonymously collecting and reporting statistics about your login queue times to crowdsource information
about FFXIV server load. This information will be publicly available in the future; check the Discord for updates!

Future planned features include login wait time estimates, as well as duty queue time statistics, and a website
showing all of this information.

Discord URL: https://discord.waitingway.com

Currently detects:
	- Aether Currents
	- Mob Hunt Elite Marks
	- Gathering Points
	- [Experimental] Quest-related NPCs/Objects

Icon by Lumas Arkfrost

plugin_variants.author: Dalagab Group
plugin_variants.changelog: Preserve downloaded Sigmascope/security projections when Dalamud official runtime manifests replace the same source/version in the live marketplace view. Apply the same exact-source/version security merge to manually refreshed repository overlays so live manifests keep current install/update metadata without erasing server-side findings. Clear inherited security before every overlay re-evaluation and refuse cross-version or cross-source inheritance, preventing stale scan results from attaching to a different package. Normalize repository-reported download/install totals into a catalog-relative popularity index where 1.00× equals total reported downloads divided by logical plugin count. Show the daily catalog average in Discover, expose `x.xx× catalog average` on product pages, and label the existing download ordering as Popularity. Preserve Dalamud update result statuses instead of flattening `FailedDownload`/`FailedUnload`/`FailedLoad` into a generic exception. Keep failed update state attached to the affected plugin for the current Omega session, show a clear warning in Updates and on the product page, and turn the action into Retry update until it succeeds or is no longer applicable. Explain that `FailedDownload` leaves the installed version unchanged and surface the repository/status details without pretending Omega can see the HTTP exception that Dalamud internally consumed. Move the online marketplace publication contract to descriptor v2 (`omega.catalog.marketplace.v2`) with `cat-v2-*` revisions while retaining read compatibility with legacy v1 descriptors and local SQLite databases. Add a clear-X control and lighter grey background to the global search field. Show aggregate reported downloads/installations in Discover and per-plugin reported downloads/installat…

plugin_variants.changelog:
- Made it to where if you leave the cosmic area, it should auto-close the window
- Missions will now auto-select based on your current level for all classes (this was mainly a problem for sinus with dual class missions...)
    - This might still be a problem with re-rolling... though I'm not sure if I can fix this issue as easily. Go level your gatherers
- Dual class missions will also no longer bug out if you swap to a gathering class while trying to queue as a crafter class (woops)
- Added some more logging for sanity checks in the future
- Spiritbond will now check to make sure you ACTUALLY UNLOCKED IT (aka done the quest) before attempting to do so and getting itself stuck step-moon.
plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!

plugin_variants.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON

* Fix for Bard changes in dalamud, added more control over song order by @LTS-FFXIV in https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/pull/1355


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/compare/7.5.5.33...7.5.5.34
plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: Dalagab Group
plugin_variants.changelog: Preserve downloaded Sigmascope/security projections when Dalamud official runtime manifests replace the same source/version in the live marketplace view. Apply the same exact-source/version security merge to manually refreshed repository overlays so live manifests keep current install/update metadata without erasing server-side findings. Clear inherited security before every overlay re-evaluation and refuse cross-version or cross-source inheritance, preventing stale scan results from attaching to a different package. Normalize repository-reported download/install totals into a catalog-relative popularity index where 1.00× equals total reported downloads divided by logical plugin count. Show the daily catalog average in Discover, expose `x.xx× catalog average` on product pages, and label the existing download ordering as Popularity. Preserve Dalamud update result statuses instead of flattening `FailedDownload`/`FailedUnload`/`FailedLoad` into a generic exception. Keep failed update state attached to the affected plugin for the current Omega session, show a clear warning in Updates and on the product page, and turn the action into Retry update until it succeeds or is no longer applicable. Explain that `FailedDownload` leaves the installed version unchanged and surface the repository/status details without pretending Omega can see the HTTP exception that Dalamud internally consumed. plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

Open settings with /regions.

plugin_variants.description:
Brio 是一套助您在集体动作中获得高级的角色编辑与操控能力的工具集。

- 进阶角色姿态调整
	- 动中调姿
	- 位置微调不复位
	- 光影叠加与图形化摆姿模式
- 支持创建多达 239 个集体动作角色
- 自定义光源创建
- 兼容 Penumbra、Glamourer 及 Customize+ 模组
- MCDF 文件离线导入/导出至集体动作角色
- 播放 XAT .xcp 镜头轨迹文件
- 播放/融合集体动作角色动画
- 主世界与集体动作内时间/天气控制
- 切换节庆活动，最多可同时应用 4 项
- 为集体动作角色添加/移除状态效果
- 世界物体生成、动画时间轴与更多功能
plugin_variants.name: Brio
plugin_variants.punchline: 增强集体动作体验！

plugin_variants.description: Load any in-game map client-side and explore it solo or with up to 20 friends, behind a packet filter that keeps the server seeing you as idle in your room. Shared weather, BGM and time; client-side mounts, emotes and minions; carpet floors for spots without collision; head-tilt and gaze sync for roleplay; and proximity say/yell passthrough. Co-op needs a relay key (closed beta); solo mode never connects to the relay.
plugin_variants.name: HMapSync (HMS)
plugin_variants.punchline: Explore any zone together.

plugin_variants.author: ssalazar217 (SteSE)
plugin_variants.changelog:
v1.0.2.0:
- Added EchoXIV Translate (LibreTranslate) as a dedicated unlimited translation engine and added Yandex support.
- Expanded local AI support for OpenAI-compatible servers such as LM Studio and Ollama, including model configuration, connection checks, timeout control, disabled thinking mode, and response token limits.
- Added configurable translation-engine fallback with automatic recovery checks for the primary engine.
- Prevented repeated failover loops when local AI returns an empty response or is unavailable.
- Added destination-language context to translation requests and logs so the requested output language is explicit.
- Added single-request AI romanization, returning translated text and romanized text together as structured JSON.
- Updated the translated-chat window to display romanized output while preserving translated and source text according to message direction.
- Applied configuration changes immediately, including language, engine, fallback, and romanization settings.
- Fixed Papago using its current web endpoint and improved translation error handling.
plugin_variants.description:
EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple free engines (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, Local AI) with configurable fallback and automatic primary recovery.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores gratuitos (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, IA local) con respaldo configurable y recuperación automática del principal.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.
plugin_variants.name: EchoXIV
plugin_variants.punchline: Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.

plugin_variants.changelog:
**Shop Item Icons** is a lightweight plugin to display item icons instead of item category icons in shops.

Supported windows:

- **Shops:** Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- **Item Exchange:** Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- **Item Exchange (categorized):** Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- **Currency Exchange:** Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- **Grand Company Seal Exchange:** Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- **Rewards:** Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- **Exchange:** Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.

The plugin has no configuration. It just works.
plugin_variants.description:
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)
    - Open creativity for just about anything that comes up to mine! (...What? You don't think making silly challenges like doing Endsinger's Aria - Extreme with MINE in under 12 minutes a good idea? Seriously, you can make that a task if you want)
       
Inspired by the idea of "DYOM" (Design Your Own Mission) and "TTDISA" (Things To Do In San Andreas) from GTA: San Andreas as well as Simple To-Do List and other similar plugins.
plugin_variants.name: Things To Do In Eorzea
plugin_variants.punchline: Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!

raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > French is partially broken ATM pending a Dalamud merge.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

AI Use: Assist
> AI was used to inquire about translations from English to Japanese to show there was at least an attempt to show that localization is supported. However said translations may not be accurate. Anyone interested may PR or DM me their translated findings for German, Japanese and French if they so please. Thus far:
> - Full English on UI and Objective Display
> - Full Japanese [Claude+Gemini+Google Translate+DeepL+Japanese Dictionary] on UI and Objective Display
> - German only on the Objective Display with partial assistance from XIV community for macros and Claude
> - French only on the Objective DIsplay with assistance from Gemini and Clause
> 
> There was also AI assist for the localization system.

raw_manifest_json.Punchline: Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!
raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
ProxyPlayer is a plugin that allows users to control what's playing on their PC, whether it be Firefox, Spotify, or any media player from within XIV. No need to Alt-Tab to Play/Pause, just control it within the game.

## Features:
- Metadata support like Title/Cover Art of songs being played
- Support for UWP apps or browsers playing YT Music, Spotify, pretty much any media player or browser communicating on Windows' SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) protocol.
- Play/Pause, Next/Previous
- (On some players) Stop, Shuffle, Repeat, Repeat Once

## Dependency
- ProxyPlayer is dependent on a included project called `ProxyPlayerServer` which serves as a middleman between XIV/Dalamud and Windows. Due to the use of Windows API, this is needed to forward data between Windows and XIV for the plugin to work properly as it needs its own wrapper. 

## How To Test:
1. Build ProxyPlayerServer first and then ProxyServer.
2. Run plugin.

To access the plugin use `/pplayer` or click the DTR on the server info bar.

## AI Disclosure
- AI was only used to provide examples of SMTC controls in C#, thus Assisted.

# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.changelog:
**Shop Item Icons** is a lightweight plugin to display item icons instead of item category icons in shops.

Supported windows:

- **Shops:** Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- **Item Exchange:** Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- **Item Exchange (categorized):** Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- **Currency Exchange:** Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- **Grand Company Seal Exchange:** Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- **Rewards:** Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- **Exchange:** Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.

The plugin has no configuration. It just works.

plugin_variants.author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
plugin_variants.changelog: Everyone's vote on you now counts once. Rating the same person again used to stack another vote on top of the last one, so a group who play together every week piled up hundreds between them - a score of +300 could be eight people rather than three hundred. Your vote is a position now: upvote somebody and you have upvoted them, however many times you press it, and downvoting them later moves your one vote across instead of adding to it. You can change your mind whenever you like, with no day to wait out first - what counts is the last thing you said. Every vote is worth the same, from anybody. Existing scores were rebuilt to match, and almost nobody's percentage moved. Clears loads sixteen at a time as you scroll instead of numbered pages and remembers where you were, and a clear arriving while you read no longer shoves the list around - a button floats at the top of it instead. New My clears tab: every clear of your own that has gone up on the feed.

plugin_variants.description:
准备好启动：能帮你钓鱼王，还能自动出海垂钓、做空岛成就、完成一些宇宙探索任务。
Ready to go: Supports Big Fish, Ocean Fishing, Diadem farming, and automates certain Stellar Missions in Cosmic Exploration.

raw_manifest_json.Author: MistyDai
raw_manifest_json.ChangeLog:
# v2.0.0.2
- 修复：自动，修复了游动饵预备的手法问题。
- 修复：自动，修复了钓鱼笔记模式会意料外地出现分步预设的问题。
# v2.0.0.1
- 修复：文案，修复了一些文案和本地化问题。
# v2.0.0.0
- 优化：界面，主窗口全新改版，首页列出图鉴收集、宇宙探索、海钓、空岛等入口并支持搜索预设，进入后可查看目标与启动前计划并启动；预设、合集、路线、任务、钓点、策略资料均有专门页面；运行状态集中显示在运行卡片上。
- 优化：主题，默认主题改为拉海洛。
- 优化：预设，预设管理改版。
- 新增：预设，支持保存用户自定义预设，单个预设或合集可通过剪贴板复制粘贴，支持列表批量操作，误删后可恢复。
- 新增：合集，可将多个预设收藏至合集并一次性运行。
- 新增：分组，预设目录里的分类可直接作为一组预设运行。
- 新增：图鉴收集，按预设、图鉴进度和窗口情况自动排序目标，默认仅钓取尚未记录的稀有鱼，也可计入普通鱼。
- 新增：需求，启动前可查看所需条件，硬需求、建议需求、已满足分三档显示；分组和合集启动时可仅运行未完成项，或包含已完成项。
- 优化：海钓，海钓钓饵不足会阻止启动，偏少则仅提示。
- 优化：宇宙探索，宇宙探索移至主页入口并新增详情页。
- 优化：空岛，空岛（云冠群岛）移至主页入口，钓饵不足会阻止启动。
- 新增：获取途径，新增获取途径窗口，可查看物品的来源 NPC 或商店及兑换条件，并可自动导航至最近商店或在地图上标记。
- 新增：通知，提供全量、自动静默、仅重要、禁用四档一键预设，并支持各渠道独立开关；游戏切至后台时，重要事件通过 Windows 通知提醒。
- 新增：语音，语音播报换用 EdgeTTS。
- 移除：命令，移除部分旧命令及剪贴板工具命令。
- 优化：设置，设置页、认证、插件依赖等细节调整。
- 新增：设置，版本升级后会弹窗引导设置语言与字体缩放。
- 修复：界面，修正界面与通知的英文/本地化文案。

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: Ice
plugin_variants.changelog:
- Made it to where if you leave the cosmic area, it should auto-close the window
- Missions will now auto-select based on your current level for all classes (this was mainly a problem for sinus with dual class missions...)
    - This might still be a problem with re-rolling... though I'm not sure if I can fix this issue as easily. Go level your gatherers
- Dual class missions will also no longer bug out if you swap to a gathering class while trying to queue as a crafter class (woops)
- Added some more logging for sanity checks in the future
- Spiritbond will now check to make sure you ACTUALLY UNLOCKED IT (aka done the quest) before attempting to do so and getting itself stuck step-moon.
plugin_variants.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!

plugin_variants.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON

## What's Changed
* Change how RSR handles non-fate mobs during fates by @LTS-FFXIV in https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/pull/1357


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/compare/7.5.5.35...7.5.5.36
plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.changelog: v0.1.2.3: Fix the in-game suggestion highlight after a call. Once you called pon, chi, or kan, the highlight could jump to the wall along the top of the board or land on the wrong tile, because it located your hand by geometry and the shrunken hand let the perfectly-aligned wall slots win. It now anchors to the bottom-most row (your hand is always at the bottom) and ignores melded tiles, so the outline stays on the suggested discard. The hand reading and suggestion were always correct; only the on-tile outline was affected.

plugin_variants.author: The Combat Reborn Team
plugin_variants.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Change how RSR handles non-fate mobs during fates by @LTS-FFXIV in https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/pull/1357


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn/compare/7.5.5.35...7.5.5.36
plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.
plugin_variants.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugin_variants.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

plugin_variants.author: Yesanith
plugin_variants.description:
Announces the region, zone, area and sub-area you walk into with a styled, animated on-screen notification. It can announce weather changes too, and redraw the game's own banners — Quest Accepted, Duty Commenced, Level Up! — in the same style.

Every line takes its own colours, outline, drop shadow and font — one of the game's own faces, or any font file on your PC.

Inspired by Nekres' "Regions of Tyria" for Guild Wars 2.

Open settings with /regions.
plugin_variants.name: Regions of XIV
plugin_variants.punchline: A beautiful area notification as you walk in and out of zones.

plugin_variants.author: OOF Games
plugin_variants.changelog:
Introducing Aetheric Flow!

Adds a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte on every map link in chat.

Key Features:
- Adds a clickable teleport link after map coordinates in chat.
- Picks the nearest aetheryte you have attuned in that zone.
- /aftp teleports to the most recent map link for controller players.
- Choose which chat channels are scanned.
- English, Japanese, German and French are all supported.
plugin_variants.description:
Display a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte for the map link from the in-game chat.

ゲーム内チャットのマップリンクに、最寄りのエーテライトへのテレポリンクを表示します。

Zeigt zu jedem Kartenlink im Spielchat einen Teleport-Link zum nächstgelegenen Ätheryten an.

Affiche un lien de téléportation vers l'éthérite la plus proche pour les liens de carte du chat en jeu.

plugin_variants.punchline: Adds a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte on every map link in chat.

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: XivHub
plugin_variants.description:
Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Every run is previewed item by item with the reason for each decision, and nothing moves until you confirm.

plugin_variants.author: yocopk
plugin_variants.description:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

An all-in-one home for quality-of-life tools that link FINAL FANTASY XIV to your MogHouse account. Tools are added over time; each one can be switched on or off individually, and nothing leaves the game unless you enable it.

Timers: reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U), including submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, custom deliveries and allied society dailies, and syncs them to your profile. MogHouse then pushes you a notification the moment one comes up, on web and mobile, even while the game and your PC are off. Voyages are timed to the last vessel back, so one notification means the whole fleet is home.

Duty Finder: when the confirm window appears, MogHouse pushes the duty or roulette name to your phone, so you know whether it is worth the sprint back to the desk. By default it stays quiet while the game is the window you are looking at.

The plugin is read-only: it collects your own data and reports status. It never performs an in-game action — it will not commence a duty for you, and it does not skip, confirm or automate anything.

Open it with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account, and a free one is enough: it syncs one character and sends one timer alert of your choosing, plus duty pops. Mog+ lifts both limits and warns you before a timer lands rather than as it does.
plugin_variants.name: MogHouse Companion
plugin_variants.punchline: Quality-of-life tools that connect your game to MogHouse. Timers and duty pops, pushed to your phone.

plugin_variants.author: XivHub
plugin_variants.description:
Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Every run is previewed item by item with the reason for each decision, and nothing moves until you confirm.

Also does the reverse (pulling gearset pieces back into the armoury) and offers a discard picker: an icon grid of leftover gear, framed by rarity, where anything equipped, in a gearset, or on your allowlist is never listed.
plugin_variants.name: InventoryCleaner
plugin_variants.punchline: Keep only the gear you actually use.

plugin_variants.author: XivHub
plugin_variants.description: Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Reads each listing straight from game memory, clicks the in-game market board's Compare Prices to find the current cheapest offering, and sets your asking price to one below it. Your own retainers and housing mannequins are never treated as competitors, so two retainers selling the same item don't chase each other down. No server, no telemetry, nothing leaves your client. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer-list controls and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional (used only to pause its automation during a pinch run).
plugin_variants.name: AutoPincher
plugin_variants.punchline: One-click undercut of every retainer listing, fully local.

plugin_variants.author: XivHub
plugin_variants.description:
Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Every run is previewed item by item with the reason for each decision, and nothing moves until you confirm.

Also does the reverse (pulling gearset pieces back into the armoury) and offers a discard picker: an icon grid of leftover gear, framed by rarity, where anything equipped, in a gearset, or on your allowlist is never listed.
plugin_variants.name: InventoryCleaner
plugin_variants.punchline: Keep only the gear you actually use.

plugin_variants.author: yocopk
plugin_variants.description:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

An all-in-one home for quality-of-life tools that link FINAL FANTASY XIV to your MogHouse account. Tools are added over time; each one can be switched on or off individually, and nothing leaves the game unless you enable it.

Timers: reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U), including submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, custom deliveries and allied society dailies, and syncs them to your profile. MogHouse then pushes you a notification the moment one comes up, on web and mobile, even while the game and your PC are off. Voyages are timed to the last vessel back, so one notification means the whole fleet is home.

Duty Finder: when the confirm window appears, MogHouse pushes the duty or roulette name to your phone, so you know whether it is worth the sprint back to the desk. By default it stays quiet while the game is the window you are looking at.

The plugin is read-only: it collects your own data and reports status. It never performs an in-game action — it will not commence a duty for you, and it does not skip, confirm or automate anything.

Open it with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account, and a free one is enough: it syncs one character and sends one timer alert of your choosing, plus duty pops. Mog+ lifts both limits and warns you before a timer lands rather than as it does.
plugin_variants.name: MogHouse Companion
plugin_variants.punchline: Quality-of-life tools that connect your game to MogHouse. Timers and duty pops, pushed to your phone.

plugin_variants.author: nxships
plugin_variants.description:
Track players you meet in FFXIV — who they are, when you ran into them, how their characters change over time. A focused social tracker built on the NexusKit framework.

Per-player detail view with Summary, Equipment, Class/Jobs, Achievements, Free Company, Encounters, History and Notes tabs. Optional enrichment from Lodestone (gear, FC link, achievement progress) and FFXIVCollect (mounts, minions, full achievement catalog). Live throttled refresh queue keeps external data fresh without hammering either service.

Configurable chat and toast notifications when players you've seen before change — rename, server transfer, Free Company join/leave/switch, achievement growth, refresh failures. Per-event filtering and history grouping so the chat doesn't drown you.

Powerful player-filter language with live preview to slice your list however you want; encounter history scoped per duty and content type; optional bridges to other Dalamud plugins (Lifestream world-travel, more to come).

Local-first: all data lives in a single SQLite file under your XIVLauncher config. Automated weekly maintenance keeps it tidy. English and German localization.
plugin_variants.name: PlayerNexusTracker
plugin_variants.punchline: Track every adventurer you meet in Eorzea.

plugin_variants.changelog:
**Scrollable Tabs** is a lightweight plugin that lets you use the mouse wheel to switch tabs.

The following windows are supported and can be toggled individually:

- Aether Currents
- Armoury Chest
- Blue Magic Spellbook
- Character
- Character -> Classes/Jobs
- Character -> Reputation
- Chocobo Saddlebag
- Companion
- Currency
- Facewear
- Fashion Accessories
- Field Records
- Fish Guide
- Glamour Dresser (scrolls pages, not tabs)
- Gold Saucer -> Card List
- Gold Saucer -> Decks -> Edit Deck
- Gold Saucer -> Lord of Verminion -> Minion Hotbar
- Inventory
- Island Minion Guide
- Minions
- Mounts
- Retainer Inventory
- Shared FATE
- Sightseeing Log

The Command Panel already includes this functionality and instead has an option to disable its tab-scrolling sound effect.

Plugin configuration is available via Plugin Installer.
plugin_variants.description:
Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts. Works in all game text inputs: chat, macros, search, etc.

    Supported shortcuts:
        - Ctrl + Left/Right: Jump between words
        - Ctrl + Shift + Left/Right: Select word by word
        - Ctrl + Backspace/Delete: Delete words
        - Ctrl + Insert: Copy
        - Shift + Insert: Paste
        - Shift + Delete: Cut

    Changes:
        - Pressing Left/Right with the cursor at the start/end of an input properly clears the selection instead of doing nothing.
        - Clearing an active selection with Left/Right moves the cursor to the beginning/end of the selection.

    Setting:
        - Configurable word boundary: Choose whether Ctrl + Right jumps to word ends (Discord, IDEs) or word starts (Windows, Notepad++, ImGui).
plugin_variants.name: InputFlow
plugin_variants.punchline: Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing behaviors.

plugin_variants.author: Cytraen, yomishino
plugin_variants.changelog: Update for 7.2 / API 12
plugin_variants.description:
This plugin detects certain objects/NPCs such as Aether Currents nearby and shows where they are by various ways, e.g. pointing to their locations on screen and notifying you in Chat.

Currently detects:
	- Aether Currents
	- Eureka Elementals (by apetih)
	- Mob Hunt Elite Marks
	- Gathering Points
	- [Experimental] Island Sanctuary Gathering Objects and Animals
	- [Experimental] Quest-related NPCs/Objects 

Note: Because most objects/NPCs are not loaded when they are too faraway or when there are too many entities nearby (such as too many player characters), they will not be detected in this case.

Icon by Lumas Arkfrost
plugin_variants.name: Aether Compass
plugin_variants.punchline: Compasses that detect and mark certain nearby objects/NPCs

plugin_variants.changelog: Minor bug fixes including the rendering of item data on a new week, sometimes would still display the previous weeks item list instead. Disabled the judging window due to problem detecting the opening of the FashionCheck addon during judging until I can find a work around.
plugin_variants.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
plugin_variants.name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugin_variants.punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!

plugin_variants.author: ssalazar217 (SteSE)
plugin_variants.changelog:
v1.0.2.0:
- Added EchoXIV Translate (LibreTranslate) as a dedicated unlimited translation engine and added Yandex support.
- Expanded local AI support for OpenAI-compatible servers such as LM Studio and Ollama, including model configuration, connection checks, timeout control, disabled thinking mode, and response token limits.
- Added configurable translation-engine fallback with automatic recovery checks for the primary engine.
- Prevented repeated failover loops when local AI returns an empty response or is unavailable.
- Added destination-language context to translation requests and logs so the requested output language is explicit.
- Added single-request AI romanization, returning translated text and romanized text together as structured JSON.
- Updated the translated-chat window to display romanized output while preserving translated and source text according to message direction.
- Applied configuration changes immediately, including language, engine, fallback, and romanization settings.
- Fixed Papago using its current web endpoint and improved translation error handling.
plugin_variants.description:
EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple free engines (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, Local AI) with configurable fallback and automatic primary recovery.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores gratuitos (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, IA local) con respaldo configurable y recuperación automática del principal.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.
plugin_variants.name: EchoXIV
plugin_variants.punchline: Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.
