plugin_variants.author: Bronya Rand
plugin_variants.changelog:
Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > French is partially broken ATM pending a Dalamud merge.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

AI Use: Assist
> AI was used to inquire about translations from English to Japanese to show there was at least an attempt to show that localization is supported. However said translations may not be accurate. Anyone interested may PR or DM me their translated findings for German, Japanese and French if they so please. Thus far:
> - Full English on UI and Objective Display
> - Full Japanese [Claude+Gemini+Google Translate+DeepL+Japanese Dictionary] on UI and Objective Display
> - German only on the Objective Display with partial assistance from XIV community for macros and Claude
> - French only on the Objective DIsplay with assistance from Gemini and Clause
> 
> There was also AI assist for the localization system.
plugin_variants.description:
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)

raw_manifest_json.Changelog:
Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > French is partially broken ATM pending a Dalamud merge.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

Anyone interested may PR or DM me their translated findings for German, Japanese and French if they so please. Thus far:
> - Full English on UI and Objective Display

> - German only on the Objective Display with partial assistance from XIV community for macros and Claude
> - French only on the Objective DIsplay with assistance from Gemini and Clause
> 
> There was also AI assist for the localization system.

plugin_variants.author: Bronya Rand
plugin_variants.changelog:
ProxyPlayer is a plugin that allows users to control what's playing on their PC, whether it be Firefox, Spotify, or any media player from within XIV. No need to Alt-Tab to Play/Pause, just control it within the game.

## Features:
- Metadata support like Title/Cover Art of songs being played
- Support for UWP apps or browsers playing YT Music, Spotify, pretty much any media player or browser communicating on Windows' SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) protocol.
- Play/Pause, Next/Previous
- (On some players) Stop, Shuffle, Repeat, Repeat Once

## Dependency
- ProxyPlayer is dependent on a included project called `ProxyPlayerServer` which serves as a middleman between XIV/Dalamud and Windows. Due to the use of Windows API, this is needed to forward data between Windows and XIV for the plugin to work properly as it needs its own wrapper. 

## How To Test:
1. Build ProxyPlayerServer first and then ProxyServer.
2. Run plugin.

To access the plugin use `/pplayer` or click the DTR on the server info bar.

## AI Disclosure
- AI was only used to provide examples of SMTC controls in C#, thus Assisted.
plugin_variants.description:
ProxyPlayer is a simple plugin that allows you to control your computer's media playback from within XIV.

Control your media player from within the game, without having to alt-tab or use a second monitor.
Features (depending on your media player):
- Play/Pause
- Next/Previous Track
- Stop
- Progress Bar
- Cover Art Display
- Metadata

ProxyPlayer comes with either a compact or portrait UI for displaying your media information.
plugin_variants.name: ProxyPlayer
plugin_variants.punchline: Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!

# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

- Added single-request AI romanization, returning translated text and romanized text together as structured JSON.
- Updated the translated-chat window to display romanized output while preserving translated and source text according to message direction.
- Applied configuration changes immediately, including language, engine, fallback, and romanization settings.

This plugin detects certain objects/NPCs such as Aether Currents nearby and shows where they are by various ways, e.g. pointing to their locations on screen and notifying you in Chat.

	- Aether Currents
	- Eureka Elementals (by apetih)
	- Mob Hunt Elite Marks

Note: Because most objects/NPCs are not loaded when they are too faraway or when there are too many entities nearby (such as too many player characters), they will not be detected in this case.

plugin_variants.author: Koizumi
plugin_variants.changelog:
# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

**Initial release of WukLamark to 'testing/live'**
## What's New
- Create and manage custom waymarks that display visibly on both the Main Map and Minimap.
- Highly customizable markers: Use simple shapes (with custom colors) or pick from hundreds of in-game icons.
- Waymark Groups: Organize your waymarks into nested, collapsible categories.
- Waymark/Group Scopes: Designate waymarks and/or groups as "Personal" (locked to your specific character) or "Shared" (visible to all characters that log in on your PC).
- Read-Only Waymarks/Groups (for Shared Waymarks/Groups): Protect shared waymarks and groups as "Read-Only" so you (or someone else) don't accidentally edit or delete them!
- Import/Export: Easy clipboard sharing to distribute groups of waymarks to your friends.

# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.author: Rietty
plugin_variants.changelog:
**Shop Item Icons** is a lightweight plugin to display item icons instead of item category icons in shops.

Supported windows:

- **Shops:** Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- **Item Exchange:** Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- **Item Exchange (categorized):** Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- **Currency Exchange:** Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- **Grand Company Seal Exchange:** Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- **Rewards:** Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- **Exchange:** Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.

The plugin has no configuration. It just works.

Settings Enhanced allows you to create zone-specific system and character configurations; For example, you could lower the amount of rendered players in Limsa, or mute other players sound effects while in stellar crafting zones. Your original configuration data is stored and automatically re-applies when entering an area with you have not created zone setting for, or when disabling the plugin/closing the game.

It is recommended that you create regular backups whilst using this plugin incase something does does break - upon install a check will be ran to see if at least one system/character configuration backup has been created; You will not be able to use the plugin if until you have created one.

plugin_variants.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
plugin_variants.name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugin_variants.punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!

plugin_variants.author: Zeffuro, Pie Lover
plugin_variants.changelog:
Adds a fast symbol picker letting you quickly insert any symbols into supported in-game text fields.
It is designed to make commonly used symbols easier to access without manually copying them from third-parties or typing them every time.

## Features
- Adds a floating quick-access "♥" button for opening the symbol popup
  - Allows the "♥" button position to be changed through drag-and-drop repositioning
  - Provides a symbol popup for quickly selecting and inserting symbols
  - List shows ALL existing custom symbols for FFXIV
- Supports opening the symbol popup through a configurable keybind
- Ensures only one symbol popup is open at a time
- Allows keybind-opened popups to be temporarily moved by dragging empty space inside the popup
- Includes a character selector toggle option for symbol selection behavior
- Adds an optional "Close popup on lost focus" setting to auto-close the popup when clicking outside of it
- Adds quick popup controls for closing the popup, changing the "♥" button position and opening the config window
- Includes a help tooltip explaining how to properly use some features

## Notes
The plugin is intended as a lightweight quality-of-life tool for players who frequently use special symbols in chat, search fields, notes or others

plugin_variants.author: ssalazar217 (SteSE)
plugin_variants.changelog:
v1.0.2.0:
- Added EchoXIV Translate (LibreTranslate) as a dedicated unlimited translation engine and added Yandex support.
- Expanded local AI support for OpenAI-compatible servers such as LM Studio and Ollama, including model configuration, connection checks, timeout control, disabled thinking mode, and response token limits.
- Added configurable translation-engine fallback with automatic recovery checks for the primary engine.
- Prevented repeated failover loops when local AI returns an empty response or is unavailable.
- Added destination-language context to translation requests and logs so the requested output language is explicit.
- Added single-request AI romanization, returning translated text and romanized text together as structured JSON.
- Updated the translated-chat window to display romanized output while preserving translated and source text according to message direction.
- Applied configuration changes immediately, including language, engine, fallback, and romanization settings.
- Fixed Papago using its current web endpoint and improved translation error handling.
plugin_variants.description:
EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple free engines (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, Local AI) with configurable fallback and automatic primary recovery.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores gratuitos (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, IA local) con respaldo configurable y recuperación automática del principal.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.
plugin_variants.name: EchoXIV
plugin_variants.punchline: Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.

plugin_variants.author: ryankhart
plugin_variants.changelog:
**Shop Item Icons** is a lightweight plugin to display item icons instead of item category icons in shops.

Supported windows:

- **Shops:** Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- **Item Exchange:** Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- **Item Exchange (categorized):** Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- **Currency Exchange:** Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- **Grand Company Seal Exchange:** Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- **Rewards:** Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- **Exchange:** Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.

The plugin has no configuration. It just works.

# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.description:
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)
    - Open creativity for just about anything that comes up to mine! (...What? You don't think making silly challenges like doing Endsinger's Aria - Extreme with MINE in under 12 minutes a good idea? Seriously, you can make that a task if you want)
       
Inspired by the idea of "DYOM" (Design Your Own Mission) and "TTDISA" (Things To Do In San Andreas) from GTA: San Andreas as well as Simple To-Do List and other similar plugins.
plugin_variants.name: Things To Do In Eorzea
plugin_variants.punchline: Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!

raw_manifest_json.Punchline: Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!
raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > French is partially broken ATM pending a Dalamud merge.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

AI Use: Assist
> AI was used to inquire about translations from English to Japanese to show there was at least an attempt to show that localization is supported. However said translations may not be accurate. Anyone interested may PR or DM me their translated findings for German, Japanese and French if they so please. Thus far:
> - Full English on UI and Objective Display
> - Full Japanese [Claude+Gemini+Google Translate+DeepL+Japanese Dictionary] on UI and Objective Display
> - German only on the Objective Display with partial assistance from XIV community for macros and Claude
> - French only on the Objective DIsplay with assistance from Gemini and Clause
> 
> There was also AI assist for the localization system.

raw_manifest_json.Punchline: Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!
raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
ProxyPlayer is a plugin that allows users to control what's playing on their PC, whether it be Firefox, Spotify, or any media player from within XIV. No need to Alt-Tab to Play/Pause, just control it within the game.

## Features:
- Metadata support like Title/Cover Art of songs being played
- Support for UWP apps or browsers playing YT Music, Spotify, pretty much any media player or browser communicating on Windows' SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) protocol.
- Play/Pause, Next/Previous
- (On some players) Stop, Shuffle, Repeat, Repeat Once

## Dependency
- ProxyPlayer is dependent on a included project called `ProxyPlayerServer` which serves as a middleman between XIV/Dalamud and Windows. Due to the use of Windows API, this is needed to forward data between Windows and XIV for the plugin to work properly as it needs its own wrapper. 

## How To Test:
1. Build ProxyPlayerServer first and then ProxyServer.
2. Run plugin.

To access the plugin use `/pplayer` or click the DTR on the server info bar.

## AI Disclosure
- AI was only used to provide examples of SMTC controls in C#, thus Assisted.

plugin_variants.author: grittyfrog
plugin_variants.changelog:
# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.author: Aireil
plugin_variants.description:
Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts. Works in all game text inputs: chat, macros, search, etc.

    Supported shortcuts:
        - Ctrl + Left/Right: Jump between words
        - Ctrl + Shift + Left/Right: Select word by word
        - Ctrl + Backspace/Delete: Delete words
        - Ctrl + Insert: Copy
        - Shift + Insert: Paste
        - Shift + Delete: Cut

    Changes:
        - Pressing Left/Right with the cursor at the start/end of an input properly clears the selection instead of doing nothing.
        - Clearing an active selection with Left/Right moves the cursor to the beginning/end of the selection.

    Setting:
        - Configurable word boundary: Choose whether Ctrl + Right jumps to word ends (Discord, IDEs) or word starts (Windows, Notepad++, ImGui).
plugin_variants.name: InputFlow
plugin_variants.punchline: Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing behaviors.

plugin_variants.author: The Redheaded Witch, WillWolf76
plugin_variants.changelog: Fixed some minor bugs.
plugin_variants.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
plugin_variants.name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugin_variants.punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!

plugin_variants.description:
Discover active FFXIV venues with data powered by the FFXIV Venues API. Browse currently open and upcoming venues in a sortable table featuring color-coded data centers, opening times, and a visual timeline. Filter by region, search by name, and adjust the lookahead window to find venues opening soon.

Save favorites, blacklist venues, and add your own custom venues with custom schedules and tags. Lifestream integration lets you teleport directly to any venue, while a compact popout window gives you a quick overview at a glance.

Use /avf to open.

plugin_variants.punchline: Browse FFXIV venues and teleport to them with one click.

plugin_variants.author: Liza Carvelli, a1hena
plugin_variants.changelog:
ec459fc: Update ARControl.csproj
f0ea323: Remove DiscardHelper integration
ea6de7c: Modernize codebase with C# 12 features

- Adopt primary constructors in VentureResolver, AutoRetainerReflection, and VentureListTab
  - Reduces boilerplate code by eliminating field declarations and assignments
  - Parameters are directly accessible throughout the class
- Standardize collection expressions using [] syntax
  - Replace 'new Dictionary<>()' with '[]' for cleaner initialization
  - Replace 'new List<>()' with '[]' for consistency
- Simplify LINQ queries by replacing .Where().Cast<>() with .OfType<>()
  - More efficient and cleaner null filtering
  - Removes unnecessary null-forgiving operators (!)
- Update array initializers to use collection expression syntax

These changes reduce code complexity while maintaining full compatibility with .NET 10 and C# 12.
1138beb: Switch to ECommons DalamudReflector

- Replace custom DalamudReflector implementation with ECommons.Reflection.DalamudReflector
- Simplify AutoRetainerReflection by removing IDisposable pattern (static method usage)
- Delete ARControl/Internal/DalamudReflector.cs (117 lines)
- Update .gitignore to exclude .claude/ directory

plugin_variants.author: XivHub
plugin_variants.description: Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Reads each listing straight from game memory, clicks the in-game market board's Compare Prices to find the current cheapest offering, and sets your asking price to one below it. Your own retainers and housing mannequins are never treated as competitors, so two retainers selling the same item don't chase each other down. No server, no telemetry, nothing leaves your client. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer-list controls and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional (used only to pause its automation during a pinch run).
plugin_variants.name: AutoPincher
plugin_variants.punchline: One-click undercut of every retainer listing, fully local.

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

plugin_variants.description: Coppelia provides guided setup for three mutually exclusive automation modes. HealBot runs configurable WHM, SCH, AST, or SGE healing, raises, buffs, and pre-buffs for up to 20 watched friendly targets. Jacqueline of All Trades (JOT) gives that healing absolute priority, then uses the equipped healer's highest available single-target filler spell only when the healing decision is idle and an eligible damaged enemy is already targeting FrenRider's configured visible Fren or the local healer. PowerlevelBot retains its BRD/MCH instant-action policy. Includes dependency/readiness checks, optional saved targets, and optional Rotation Solver Reborn isolation for HealBot and JOT. plugin_variants.changelog: v0.1.2.3: Fix the in-game suggestion highlight after a call. Once you called pon, chi, or kan, the highlight could jump to the wall along the top of the board or land on the wrong tile, because it located your hand by geometry and the shrunken hand let the perfectly-aligned wall slots win. It now anchors to the bottom-most row (your hand is always at the bottom) and ignores melded tiles, so the outline stays on the suggested discard. The hand reading and suggestion were always correct; only the on-tile outline was affected.

plugin_variants.author: Valenth Siveria
plugin_variants.changelog: API15 finally
plugin_variants.description:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool
plugin_variants.name: I Am Ready
plugin_variants.punchline: Automatically accept or decline Duty Finder ready checks based on a configurable counter.

plugin_variants.author: croizat, dajoey
plugin_variants.changelog:
v0.0.1.45 - 2026-08-17
- **Pauses inside instanced content and RELEASES the Gluttony lease.** `FateGrind` had no duty gate: queuing
- **Auto-Rotation control actually works now.** `GluttonyComboIPC.Enable()` called `SetAutoRotationConfigState`
- **`InvalidLease` handled on every IPC call** (`SetAutoRotationState`, `SetAutoRotationConfigState`,
- IPC warnings are throttled to one per 10s.

v0.0.1.44 - 2026-06-27
- **Stop now halts vnavmesh immediately.** Hitting Stop (or `/lazyfate stop`) while the bot was pathfinding/flying to a FATE previously left vnavmesh navigating to the destination on its own - cancelling the plugin's task does not stop vnav's in-flight movement. `FateToolKit` Running=false and the `FateGrind` task teardown now call `Svc.Navmesh.PathfindCancelAll()` + `Svc.Navmesh.Stop()` (cancel any in-progress pathfind AND stop following the current path), so the character stops the moment you hit Stop.

v0.0.1.43 - 2026-06-27
- **Stop now fully releases the Gluttony Combo lease** instead of only disabling auto-rotation. Previously, Stop (and `/lazyfate stop`, and auto-complete) left Gluttony "controlled by Lazy Fate Automation" with the lease still held, so your manual/macro control of Gluttony stayed locked out. `FateToolKit` Running=false now calls `GluttonyComboIPC.Release()` (which calls `ReleaseControl`) instead of `Disable()`; a fresh lease is acquired on the next grind start. Between-FATE pauses still use `Disable()` (keep the lease, just stop the rotation).

v0.0.1.42 - 2026-06-27
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset `CBT - Gluttony` -> `Gluttony` (dropped the leftover "CBT -" prefix that came from the original "CBT - DwD" community preset). The status bar now reads just "Gluttony".

v0.0.1.41 - 2026-06-27
- **Critical: Gluttony Combo lease churn that crashed Gluttony and tanked FPS.** `GluttonyComboIPC` re-registered a new lease on every transient IPC hiccup; because Gluttony's `CreateRegistration` dedups on `PluginName == internalPluginName` (and `PluginName` stores the *display* name), the dedup never matched and duplicate "Lazy Fate Automation" registrations piled up. Two or more registrations make Gluttony's `Search.AllJobsControlled` `ToDictionary` (keyed by plugin name) throw on every UI render and rotation tick - dead framerate, an error dialog in Gluttony's settings window, and a non-functional toggle macro. The lease is now acquired exactly once (throttled, only when none is held) and is never dropped on a transient error - only when Gluttony itself reports the lease invalid (by then it is already removed, so re-acquiring cannot duplicate).
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset `CBT - DwD` -> `CBT - Gluttony` so the status bar reflects the new combat engine. Preset JSON re-brotli-compressed in `FateGrind._presetCompressed`; `_presetName` updated to match.
- After updating, **reload Gluttony Combo** (or restart the game) once to clear any orphaned duplicate registrations left behind by v0.0.1.40.

v0.0.1.40 - 2026-06-27
- Combat is now driven by **Gluttony Combo** instead of BossMod's "DwD" autorotation. BossMod is kept only for movement and danger avoidance; Gluttony Combo's lease-based Auto-Rotation now owns the combat rotation **and** target selection.
- `FateGrind.HandleIntegrations` enables Gluttony Combo Auto-Rotation on FATE engage via the `GluttonyCombo` IPC (RegisterForLease -> SetAutoRotationState -> SetCurrentJobAutoRotationReady), configured for FATE grinding: DPSRotationMode=Nearest, FATEPriority=on, DPSAlwaysHardTarget=on (so BossMod movement follows Gluttony's hard target), InCombatOnly=off, BypassFATE=on, DPSAoETargets=3.
- BossMod `MiscAI.AutoTarget` now yields target authority to Gluttony: `Retarget=NoTarget` (only auto-targets when the player has nothing targeted) plus `FATE=Enabled` for the bootstrap case. The `MaxTargets` pull cap is retained.
- `FateGrind.DeactivateIntegrations` and the run-stop path disable Gluttony Combo Auto-Rotation so it never fires while travelling between FATEs.
- `Helpers/IPC/GluttonyComboIPC.cs` - IPC subscriber for Gluttony Combo's lease-based Auto-Rotation (prefix `GluttonyCombo`) with lease lifecycle (register/enable/disable/release) and FATE-grinding config. Modeled on GluttonyCombo/docs/IPCExample.cs.
- `Ipc.GluttonyCombo` flag; `Service.Gluttony` instance wired into plugin start/dispose.
- Requires Gluttony Combo installed; the current job's Single-Target + AoE combos are enabled in Auto-Mode automatically. If Gluttony Combo is not loaded, the IsLoaded guard skips the integration and combat falls back to BossMod's prior behavior.
- Version jumped 0.0.1.39 -> 0.0.1.40 (no 0.0.1.39 CHANGELOG entry existed; this entry covers the combat-engine switch).
plugin_variants.description: Automates FATE grinding, including Zodiac Atma, Anima Luminous Crystals, Resistance Memories, Phantom Demiatmas, Yo-kai Watch Medals, and Bicolor Gemstones. Seamlessly integrates with vnavmesh for pathing and flight, lifestream for zone swapping, TextAdvance for dialogue skipping, and Gluttony Combo/BossMod for combat. Use /lazyfate to open.
plugin_variants.name: Lazy Fate Automation
plugin_variants.punchline: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.

plugin_variants.changelog: - Updated for patch 7.5
plugin_variants.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

plugin_variants.author: Legends of the Game
plugin_variants.changelog:
Our largest update since 3.0.

Native window - Story Remaining:
- Add Story Remaining to the Native overview. It existed only in Classic, so switching to the window being actively developed cost you the projection that most justifies the plugin.
- Reproduce Classic's wording exactly, down to the singular "quest" when one is left and the gate sentence being dropped on the final expansion.
- Move the calculation out of Classic's draw code into a shared helper both windows now call, so the two can no longer drift apart or disagree on a figure.
- Quote a single pacing figure. Story Remaining previously cited the Main Scenario rate three rows under a row showing the same number, so "28m per quest" could sit above "at your rate of 28m 16s per quest".
- Make the overview panel scroll, and raise its capacity from 26 rows to 48. At the 460px minimum window size the surplus rows did not vanish - they drew over the window's own border.
- Hide a row's whole container rather than just its text, so the scrollbar describes the rows you can actually see instead of counting hidden ones.
- Say so, once, if the row pool is ever exhausted. Silently dropping the surplus is why the old ceiling went unnoticed for as long as it did.

Native window - News and Bonuses:
- Merge News and What's New into one "News/What's New" tab, News taking the upper 60%. Both panels are unchanged; they are composed rather than rewritten.
- Add a Bonuses tab showing your fed status and the current food recommendation. The information was already read live, but the full window never had access to it - only the companion window did.
- List every food you are holding, grouped into Combat, Crafting and Gathering by which stats the item actually grants, rather than guessed from its name.
- Rank food within each group using the same cap-first scoring already used to choose the single recommendation, so the tab and the recommendation cannot contradict each other.
- List NQ and HQ of the same item as separate rows, since their bonuses differ, and highlight only the row for the quality you are actually holding.

Recommendations:
- Offer the ten oldest unfinished quests instead of one. The pane it opens into already scrolled and already held a dozen job quests, so nothing new was needed to show them.
- Keep the single quest Classic names unchanged. Ten entries meant deciding what happens when two quests tie on both patch and level; the new ordering was checked against the old one over 20,000 generated cases built to collide often, and the top entry matched every time.
- Cost nothing extra on a new character. The list is built by bounded insertion rather than sorting - on a character with almost nothing complete, sorting five thousand quests to keep ten would throw away 99.8% of the work.
- Add a setting to leave class and job quests out of the shortlist, on by default. Every A Realm Reborn class has an unlock quest at level 1 in patch 2.0, so they tie on both sort keys and could fill all ten slots on a character who has not taken them all.
- Offer it as a setting rather than a filter, because they genuinely are the oldest outstanding quests. Someone working through the classes wants them listed; someone who never intends to wants that corner of the backlog out of the way.
- Match those quests by their English titles, the same method the totals and the export already use, so the setting behaves identically on every client language rather than silently doing nothing.
- Leave the tree, the totals and the export untouched. The setting says what to recommend, not what your character has done.
- Apply the setting immediately. It previously recomputed the shortlist while the screen showed the old one, and only corrected itself when you closed and reopened the window.
- Preserve your scroll position when nothing relevant changed. The list rebuilds when the setting has moved, not on every visit to the tab.
- Hide Recommended entirely under the Done filter. Every quest in it is unfinished by definition, so each branch opened onto blankness rather than saying nothing matched.

Achievement counts:
- Show collectables and duty counts without requiring you to open one specific achievement page first. These came from a single slot holding whichever achievement the client last fetched, so for most characters the three counts simply stayed blank.
- Read them instead from which achievement tiers you have completed, which is available all at once and needs no request to the server.
- Present the result as a guaranteed floor rather than a running total. A completed tier proves you reached its requirement; it cannot tell you how far past it you are.
- Take the reading once per session, since a completed tier cannot become uncompleted.
- Recover the requirement from each achievement's description, because no column in the game's own data holds it.
- Discard an entire achievement series if its parsed requirements do not increase with its tiers. A reworded tier or an unfamiliar language shows up as nonsense ordering, and no figure at all is better than a wrong one presented as a guarantee.
- Name the specific achievement to open in the companion window's hint. The old wording said to open Achievements once, which was wrong - the window can be open and still show nothing.

Adventurer's Ledger export:
- Add thirteen unlock keys the ledger had been approximating from your story patch: a daily key and an elite key for each of the five Hunt boards, plus allied societies, Zodiac and raids.
- Treat the Hunt as five features rather than one. Each expansion has its own board, its own unlock chain and its own weekly elite bill.
- Include Zodiac, previously left out because "A Relic Reborn" is per weapon. The ledger's row is Morbid Motivation, and all thirteen weapon quests converge well before it, so a single quest answers it.
- Keep the existing "eliteHunt" name even though it has always meant the Heavensward chain specifically. Published builds already send it and its value has not changed - only which ledger row should read it was wrong.

Notes:
- New settings arrive with defaults; nothing needs configuring after updating.
- Per-item bag and slot location for food was built and then dropped. The bag reads back correctly, but the inventory window's layout is a client display setting that plugins cannot see, so any "row 3, slot 5" would have been wrong for some players and right for others with no way to tell which.

Something not working, or a figure that looks wrong? Please reach out.
plugin_variants.description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugin_variants.name: Time Memoria
plugin_variants.punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.

Contributes and utilizes crowdsourced login, duty, and roulette queue information for the benefit of everyone.

Current features include queue time estimates and notifications via Discord, so you can know when you make it into the game, as well as anonymously collecting and reporting statistics about your queue times to crowdsource information about FFXIV server load and activity. Join our Discord for more information!

Discord URL: https://waiting.camora.dev/discord

plugin_variants.author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
plugin_variants.changelog: Five Party Finder categories that could not be posted at all now can: Deep Dungeons, Treasure Hunt, FATEs, PvP and Duty Roulette. Each used to put a listing up with the wrong duty attached or with none, and three of them were offering names the game's own recruitment window has never had - deep dungeons were listed per floor set, treasure hunts as the dungeons a map opens into. They are listed the way the game lists them now, and a preset for one posts as that duty. Treasure hunts are also always limited to your own world, the way FATEs and hunt trains are, because the dig only happens on the world it was started on. Party Finder can also show you what a locked duty actually is, if you turn it on in Settings - listings the game labels "Locked Duty" get the fight's real name back, still marked so you can tell you cannot join. A prompt now dims and holds the whole plugin rather than one window, and the dimming behind it appears at all, which it never had.

plugin_variants.punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.

Bring your Glamourer designs across. Copy one in Glamourer, then press Paste Design in the Outfits pane.
Copy Design puts what you are wearing on the clipboard, ready to paste into Glamourer.
An imported outfit dresses you from bare, so the slots the design leaves empty are emptied rather than left as they were.
A design that hides your headgear or your weapon is imported hidden too.
Glasses, advanced dyes and Penumbra settings cannot come across. EchoGlam tells you what a design was carrying before you save it.
Hide now works both ways. Press it again to put back whatever was in the slot.

No other plugins required.

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

plugin_variants.author: Legends of the Game
plugin_variants.changelog:
Native window improvements: a cleaner News tab, an at-a-glance achievement total, and role-coloured, correctly-ranked food.

News and What's New:
- Merge What's New into the News tab. It was dormant between content patches and had one line to say the rest of the year while permanently holding 40% of the tab's height for it - now it's one continuous panel that only grows a list when there is something to list.
- List up to 60 new quests on a big patch, and say so ("...and N more") rather than silently dropping the rest.

Overview:
- Add an "Achievements" section - "Overall X/Y Z%" - the same grand tally the game's own Achievements window shows, in both Classic and Native.
- Hidden until that window has loaded this login, the same way other totals hide rather than showing a false 0/0.
- Fixes a related gap: switching characters mid-session could silently skip this and other free achievement reads for every character after the first.

Bonuses:
- Colour each held food's stat line by role - Tank, Healer, DPS, Crafter, Gatherer - matching the palette Progression already uses.
- Fix a ranking bug: food was scored by summing every stat's cap regardless of relevance, so a Skill Speed/Direct Hit food could outrank a Piety food for a healer. Ranking now counts only the stats your equipped gear actually uses.
- Rank held food by your real, current stat totals while you are not fed, instead of assuming every food reaches its cap; falls back to the simpler cap-based ranking while fed, since your current total already includes that food's own bonus and multiplying it in again would double-count it.
- Pin the food you are currently eating to the top of its group.

Something not working, or a figure that looks wrong? Please reach out.
plugin_variants.description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugin_variants.name: Time Memoria
plugin_variants.punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

plugin_variants.author: dajoey
plugin_variants.changelog:
v0.1.0.13 - 2026-08-25
- **`PvPHighestPressure` targeting mode** (issue #4, requested by @Petra105). Selects the hostile the most members of your own side are currently targeting, breaking ties toward the lowest HP percentage. Party and alliance lists are both counted, so it behaves in Frontline (where the rest of your side arrives as alliance members) as well as in Crystalline Conflict. Your own current target is excluded from the count, otherwise the mode would reinforce whatever you were already on. Appended to the end of `TargetingType`, so existing saved `TargetingTypes` indices are unaffected, and it is **not** added to the default list - it is opt-in from Target settings. (`PvPSolver.Basic/Data/TargetType.cs`, `PvPSolver.Basic/Actions/ActionTargetInfo.cs`)

- **Auto-target abandoned an enemy mid damage-window** (issue #4, same report). `FindHostileRaw` re-ranked every hostile from scratch on each action and returned the top of the list, with no reference to the target already selected; `RSCommands.DoAction` then hard-assigned `Svc.Targets.Target` to it. Under an HP-based targeting mode this flips target the instant another enemy's HP crosses yours, so a just-applied Wildfire is left on someone you have stopped hitting. `FindHostileRaw` now consults `FindStickyTarget` before returning: if the current target is still a legal candidate **for the action being used** and carries at least one status sourced from the player with `0 < RemainingTime <= StickyTargetMaxRemaining`, it is kept. (`PvPSolver.Basic/Actions/ActionTargetInfo.cs`)

- Two new options under Target settings: **`StickyTarget`** (default **on**) and **`StickyTargetMaxRemaining`** (default 30s). The second exists so an effectively permanent aura cannot pin the target forever - `RemainingTime == 0` is this codebase's convention for a permanent status and is already excluded, and the cap covers long ones.

- **Trade-off, by design:** while your debuff is ticking the rotation will stay on that target even if another enemy drops lower. That is the requested behavior, and turning `StickyTarget` off restores the previous snap-to-lowest-HP handling exactly.
- **Scoped to PvP.** `FindStickyTarget` returns early unless `DataCenter.IsPvP`, so PvE target selection is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- Sticky selection reads `Svc.Targets.Target`, i.e. the target the previous action settled on, which is what makes this hysteresis rather than a second independent pick.
- `CountTeamPressure` scores every candidate once before sorting rather than inside the comparator; a comparator that re-reads live target data can throw `IComparer.Compare() returns inconsistent results` if a teammate switches target mid-sort.
- **Not yet verified in-game** - shipped to the testing channel only.

v0.1.0.12 - 2026-08-06
- Synced upstream RotationSolverReborn `35ceb6e82` ("Guard status check for Doom to ensure valid object"): the PvP-rotation portion of that commit is a `GameVersion` attribute bump from `7.5` to `7.55` across all 21 PvP rotations.

- **No gameplay change.** The Doom guard itself lives in `RotationSolver.Basic/Helpers/StatusHelper.cs` and upstream's PvE rotations - base classes this fork intentionally does not track (RUNBOOK 3.2). The fork's PvP rotations contain no Doom status checks, so there is nothing to port.
- Synced via `tools/sync-upstream-rotations.sh`; all 21 PvP rotation files verified byte-identical to upstream `6c064f910` (CR-normalised).
- **Promoted to production 2026-08-09.** `AssemblyVersion` 0.1.0.9 -> 0.1.0.12; both channels now ship this build. In-game gate waived by Joey: the 0.1.0.11 fix executes only outside PvP (guard on `DataCenter.IsPvP`) and this sync is attribute-only, so PvP play cannot exercise what changed; the user-facing check is the absence of the PvE `no rotation found` warning in `dalamud.log` (issue #3).

v0.1.0.11 - 2026-08-03
- **Per-frame log spam in all PvE content** (issue #3, reported by @TheWalkingDude19). `UpdateCustomRotation` is driven from the framework tick via `MajorUpdater.RSRRotationAndStateUpdate`, and emitted `WRN ... no rotation found for job=<job> combatType=PvE` roughly 50 times per second for as long as the player was outside PvP. PvPSolver is PvP-only and ships no PvE rotations, so the lookup could never succeed; worse, the miss path set `DataCenter.CurrentRotation = null` immediately before logging, which permanently defeated the unchanged-state guard at the top of the method and forced a full re-resolve every tick. (Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs)

- `UpdateCustomRotation` now returns early when `DataCenter.IsPvP` is false, clearing `CurrentRotation`/`CurrentRotationActions` once on the PvP-to-PvE transition instead of every frame. `curCombatType` is consequently always `CombatType.PvP` below that guard.
- Removed the ungated `PluginLog.Information($"UpdateCustomRotation: job=..., IsPvP=..., groups=...")` call. It ran unconditionally on every invocation, ahead of every early return - invisible to users filtering at Warning+, but hammering `dalamud.log` in PvP and PvE alike.
- Both remaining "no rotation" warnings (`no rotation found for job=...` and `No valid rotations found for ...`) are now throttled by a `_lastNoRotationLogged` (job, combat type) tuple, so a persistent miss reports once rather than once per frame. Reset in `ChangeRotation` so a later successful load re-arms the warning.

- **Shipped to production with 0.1.0.12 (2026-08-09).** In-game gate waived by Joey: every changed statement executes only when `DataCenter.IsPvP` is false, so in-PvP behavior is provably unchanged; the empirical check is that the PvE `no rotation found` warning stops firing (issue #3).
- Both log lines date to the initial vendored commit `9b3652dae`, so this affected every release to date.
- No rotation, targeting or combat behavior changes - the end state in PvE is identical (`CurrentRotation == null`), it is just no longer recomputed and re-logged every tick.

v0.1.0.10 - 2026-07-31
- Synced upstream RotationSolverReborn commit `2ac940563`: the `EmergencyGCD` hook now takes the queued next GCD as a parameter, bringing it in line with `EmergencyAbility`, interrupts, dispels and the heal hooks, which have all taken it for some time. Applied to the base engine (`PvPSolver.Basic/Rotations/CustomRotation_GCD.cs` declaration + both call sites, `PvPSolver.Basic/Rotations/Duties/DutyRotation.cs` declaration) and to the two rotations that override it (`RebornRotations/PVPRotations/Healer/WHM_Default.PVP.cs`, `RebornRotations/PVPRotations/Ranged/BRD_Default.PVP.cs`).

- **No gameplay change.** The new `nextGCD` parameter is not read by any implementation of the hook — not in this fork, and not anywhere in upstream `641bd792e`. It is plumbing for future upstream use. Purify (stun / heavy / bind / silence / deep freeze / Miracle of Nature), Guard, Recuperate and Standard-issue Elixir priority are unchanged, as are the WHM Aquaveil and BRD The Warden's Paean cleanse paths.
- `WHM_Default.PVP.cs` and `BRD_Default.PVP.cs` are now byte-identical to upstream `641bd792e` (verified by diff, CR-normalised).
- First release on the **reinstated testing channel**. The channel was removed 2026-06-07; its previous entry never worked because `TestingDalamudApiLevel` was unset, so Dalamud hid the build. Now set to 15 alongside `TestingAssemblyVersion`. Production remains 0.1.0.9 until this build is verified in-game.
- Escalated by the nightly upstream-merge on 2026-07-31 under RUNBOOK 3.2 ("never pull base classes"). RUNBOOK amended the same day with a signature-only carve-out so equivalent changes sync unattended.

v0.1.0.9 - 2026-07-02
- Hidden the three PvE-only config tabs inherited from upstream: Duty Rotation, Duty, and AutoDuty (incl. the AutoDuty helper-plugin installer list). Tabs are `[TabSkip]`-hidden, not deleted, so nightly subtree merges stay clean. (UI/RotationConfigWindowTab.cs)
- Removed upstream Combat Reborn donation/community links: Ko-fi title-bar button, About-tab Ko-fi button and Discord banner, and the "Thanks to Supporters" About section with its random supporter shout-out hints. (UI/RotationConfigWindow.cs)
- Easter egg window retitled "PvP Solver Lab" (was "RSR Lab"). (UI/EasterEggWindow.cs)

- Part of the 2026-07-02 fork-branding cleanup pass across lalalazy forks. No rotation/behavior changes.
- The Actions-tab "Intercepted" option is PvE-only by nature and remains visible; candidate for a later pass.

v0.1.0.8 - 2026-06-18
- Skip loading PvE duty rotations (Bozja, Emanation, MonsterHunter, Orbonne, Phantom, Variant) entirely. PvPSolver is PvP-only, so the duty rotation set had zero relevance; not loading it reduces memory use and startup time. (Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs)

plugin_variants.name: PvP Solver
plugin_variants.punchline: PvP-only auto-rotation

- **Promoted to production 2026-08-09.** `AssemblyVersion` 0.1.0.9 -> 0.1.0.12; both channels now ship this build. In-game gate waived by Joey: the 0.1.0.11 fix executes only outside PvP (guard on `DataCenter.IsPvP`) and this sync is attribute-only, so PvP play cannot exercise what changed; the user-facing check is the absence of the PvE `no rotation found` warning in `dalamud.log` (issue #3).

v0.1.0.11 - 2026-08-03
- **Per-frame log spam in all PvE content** (issue #3, reported by @TheWalkingDude19). `UpdateCustomRotation` is driven from the framework tick via `MajorUpdater.RSRRotationAndStateUpdate`, and emitted `WRN ... no rotation found for job=<job> combatType=PvE` roughly 50 times per second for as long as the player was outside PvP. PvPSolver is PvP-only and ships no PvE rotations, so the lookup could never succeed; worse, the miss path set `DataCenter.CurrentRotation = null` immediately before logging, which permanently defeated the unchanged-state guard at the top of the method and forced a full re-resolve every tick. (Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs)

- `UpdateCustomRotation` now returns early when `DataCenter.IsPvP` is false, clearing `CurrentRotation`/`CurrentRotationActions` once on the PvP-to-PvE transition instead of every frame. `curCombatType` is consequently always `CombatType.PvP` below that guard.
- Removed the ungated `PluginLog.Information($"UpdateCustomRotation: job=..., IsPvP=..., groups=...")` call. It ran unconditionally on every invocation, ahead of every early return - invisible to users filtering at Warning+, but hammering `dalamud.log` in PvP and PvE alike.
- Both remaining "no rotation" warnings (`no rotation found for job=...` and `No valid rotations found for ...`) are now throttled by a `_lastNoRotationLogged` (job, combat type) tuple, so a persistent miss reports once rather than once per frame. Reset in `ChangeRotation` so a later successful load re-arms the warning.

- **Shipped to production with 0.1.0.12 (2026-08-09).** In-game gate waived by Joey: every changed statement executes only when `DataCenter.IsPvP` is false, so in-PvP behavior is provably unchanged; the empirical check is that the PvE `no rotation found` warning stops firing (issue #3).
- Both log lines date to the initial vendored commit `9b3652dae`, so this affected every release to date.
- No rotation, targeting or combat behavior changes - the end state in PvE is identical (`CurrentRotation == null`), it is just no longer recomputed and re-logged every tick.

v0.1.0.10 - 2026-07-31
- Synced upstream RotationSolverReborn commit `2ac940563`: the `EmergencyGCD` hook now takes the queued next GCD as a parameter, bringing it in line with `EmergencyAbility`, interrupts, dispels and the heal hooks, which have all taken it for some time. Applied to the base engine (`PvPSolver.Basic/Rotations/CustomRotation_GCD.cs` declaration + both call sites, `PvPSolver.Basic/Rotations/Duties/DutyRotation.cs` declaration) and to the two rotations that override it (`RebornRotations/PVPRotations/Healer/WHM_Default.PVP.cs`, `RebornRotations/PVPRotations/Ranged/BRD_Default.PVP.cs`).

- **No gameplay change.** The new `nextGCD` parameter is not read by any implementation of the hook — not in this fork, and not anywhere in upstream `641bd792e`. It is plumbing for future upstream use. Purify (stun / heavy / bind / silence / deep freeze / Miracle of Nature), Guard, Recuperate and Standard-issue Elixir priority are unchanged, as are the WHM Aquaveil and BRD The Warden's Paean cleanse paths.
- `WHM_Default.PVP.cs` and `BRD_Default.PVP.cs` are now byte-identical to upstream `641bd792e` (verified by diff, CR-normalised).
- First release on the **reinstated testing channel**. The channel was removed 2026-06-07; its previous entry never worked because `TestingDalamudApiLevel` was unset, so Dalamud hid the build. Now set to 15 alongside `TestingAssemblyVersion`. Production remains 0.1.0.9 until this build is verified in-game.
- Escalated by the nightly upstream-merge on 2026-07-31 under RUNBOOK 3.2 ("never pull base classes"). RUNBOOK amended the same day with a signature-only carve-out so equivalent changes sync unattended.

v0.1.0.9 - 2026-07-02
- Hidden the three PvE-only config tabs inherited from upstream: Duty Rotation, Duty, and AutoDuty (incl. the AutoDuty helper-plugin installer list). Tabs are `[TabSkip]`-hidden, not deleted, so nightly subtree merges stay clean. (UI/RotationConfigWindowTab.cs)
- Removed upstream Combat Reborn donation/community links: Ko-fi title-bar button, About-tab Ko-fi button and Discord banner, and the "Thanks to Supporters" About section with its random supporter shout-out hints. (UI/RotationConfigWindow.cs)
- Easter egg window retitled "PvP Solver Lab" (was "RSR Lab"). (UI/EasterEggWindow.cs)

- Part of the 2026-07-02 fork-branding cleanup pass across lalalazy forks. No rotation/behavior changes.
- The Actions-tab "Intercepted" option is PvE-only by nature and remains visible; candidate for a later pass.

v0.1.0.8 - 2026-06-18
- Skip loading PvE duty rotations (Bozja, Emanation, MonsterHunter, Orbonne, Phantom, Variant) entirely. PvPSolver is PvP-only, so the duty rotation set had zero relevance; not loading it reduces memory use and startup time. (Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs)

plugin_variants.author: croizat, dajoey
plugin_variants.changelog:
v0.0.1.45 - 2026-08-17
- **Pauses inside instanced content and RELEASES the Gluttony lease.** `FateGrind` had no duty gate: queuing
- **Auto-Rotation control actually works now.** `GluttonyComboIPC.Enable()` called `SetAutoRotationConfigState`
- **`InvalidLease` handled on every IPC call** (`SetAutoRotationState`, `SetAutoRotationConfigState`,
- IPC warnings are throttled to one per 10s.

v0.0.1.44 - 2026-06-27
- **Stop now halts vnavmesh immediately.** Hitting Stop (or `/lazyfate stop`) while the bot was pathfinding/flying to a FATE previously left vnavmesh navigating to the destination on its own - cancelling the plugin's task does not stop vnav's in-flight movement. `FateToolKit` Running=false and the `FateGrind` task teardown now call `Svc.Navmesh.PathfindCancelAll()` + `Svc.Navmesh.Stop()` (cancel any in-progress pathfind AND stop following the current path), so the character stops the moment you hit Stop.

v0.0.1.43 - 2026-06-27
- **Stop now fully releases the Gluttony Combo lease** instead of only disabling auto-rotation. Previously, Stop (and `/lazyfate stop`, and auto-complete) left Gluttony "controlled by Lazy Fate Automation" with the lease still held, so your manual/macro control of Gluttony stayed locked out. `FateToolKit` Running=false now calls `GluttonyComboIPC.Release()` (which calls `ReleaseControl`) instead of `Disable()`; a fresh lease is acquired on the next grind start. Between-FATE pauses still use `Disable()` (keep the lease, just stop the rotation).

v0.0.1.42 - 2026-06-27
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset `CBT - Gluttony` -> `Gluttony` (dropped the leftover "CBT -" prefix that came from the original "CBT - DwD" community preset). The status bar now reads just "Gluttony".

v0.0.1.41 - 2026-06-27
- **Critical: Gluttony Combo lease churn that crashed Gluttony and tanked FPS.** `GluttonyComboIPC` re-registered a new lease on every transient IPC hiccup; because Gluttony's `CreateRegistration` dedups on `PluginName == internalPluginName` (and `PluginName` stores the *display* name), the dedup never matched and duplicate "Lazy Fate Automation" registrations piled up. Two or more registrations make Gluttony's `Search.AllJobsControlled` `ToDictionary` (keyed by plugin name) throw on every UI render and rotation tick - dead framerate, an error dialog in Gluttony's settings window, and a non-functional toggle macro. The lease is now acquired exactly once (throttled, only when none is held) and is never dropped on a transient error - only when Gluttony itself reports the lease invalid (by then it is already removed, so re-acquiring cannot duplicate).
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset `CBT - DwD` -> `CBT - Gluttony` so the status bar reflects the new combat engine. Preset JSON re-brotli-compressed in `FateGrind._presetCompressed`; `_presetName` updated to match.
- After updating, **reload Gluttony Combo** (or restart the game) once to clear any orphaned duplicate registrations left behind by v0.0.1.40.

v0.0.1.40 - 2026-06-27
- Combat is now driven by **Gluttony Combo** instead of BossMod's "DwD" autorotation. BossMod is kept only for movement and danger avoidance; Gluttony Combo's lease-based Auto-Rotation now owns the combat rotation **and** target selection.
- `FateGrind.HandleIntegrations` enables Gluttony Combo Auto-Rotation on FATE engage via the `GluttonyCombo` IPC (RegisterForLease -> SetAutoRotationState -> SetCurrentJobAutoRotationReady), configured for FATE grinding: DPSRotationMode=Nearest, FATEPriority=on, DPSAlwaysHardTarget=on (so BossMod movement follows Gluttony's hard target), InCombatOnly=off, BypassFATE=on, DPSAoETargets=3.
- BossMod `MiscAI.AutoTarget` now yields target authority to Gluttony: `Retarget=NoTarget` (only auto-targets when the player has nothing targeted) plus `FATE=Enabled` for the bootstrap case. The `MaxTargets` pull cap is retained.
- `FateGrind.DeactivateIntegrations` and the run-stop path disable Gluttony Combo Auto-Rotation so it never fires while travelling between FATEs.

raw_manifest_json.Changelog:
v0.0.1.45 - 2026-08-17
- **Pauses inside instanced content and RELEASES the Gluttony lease.** `FateGrind` had no duty gate: queuing
- **Auto-Rotation control actually works now.** `GluttonyComboIPC.Enable()` called `SetAutoRotationConfigState`
- **`InvalidLease` handled on every IPC call** (`SetAutoRotationState`, `SetAutoRotationConfigState`,
- IPC warnings are throttled to one per 10s.

v0.0.1.44 - 2026-06-27
- **Stop now halts vnavmesh immediately.** Hitting Stop (or `/lazyfate stop`) while the bot was pathfinding/flying to a FATE previously left vnavmesh navigating to the destination on its own - cancelling the plugin's task does not stop vnav's in-flight movement. `FateToolKit` Running=false and the `FateGrind` task teardown now call `Svc.Navmesh.PathfindCancelAll()` + `Svc.Navmesh.Stop()` (cancel any in-progress pathfind AND stop following the current path), so the character stops the moment you hit Stop.

v0.0.1.43 - 2026-06-27
- **Stop now fully releases the Gluttony Combo lease** instead of only disabling auto-rotation. Previously, Stop (and `/lazyfate stop`, and auto-complete) left Gluttony "controlled by Lazy Fate Automation" with the lease still held, so your manual/macro control of Gluttony stayed locked out. `FateToolKit` Running=false now calls `GluttonyComboIPC.Release()` (which calls `ReleaseControl`) instead of `Disable()`; a fresh lease is acquired on the next grind start. Between-FATE pauses still use `Disable()` (keep the lease, just stop the rotation).

v0.0.1.42 - 2026-06-27
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset `CBT - Gluttony` -> `Gluttony` (dropped the leftover "CBT -" prefix that came from the original "CBT - DwD" community preset). The status bar now reads just "Gluttony".

v0.0.1.41 - 2026-06-27
- **Critical: Gluttony Combo lease churn that crashed Gluttony and tanked FPS.** `GluttonyComboIPC` re-registered a new lease on every transient IPC hiccup; because Gluttony's `CreateRegistration` dedups on `PluginName == internalPluginName` (and `PluginName` stores the *display* name), the dedup never matched and duplicate "Lazy Fate Automation" registrations piled up. Two or more registrations make Gluttony's `Search.AllJobsControlled` `ToDictionary` (keyed by plugin name) throw on every UI render and rotation tick - dead framerate, an error dialog in Gluttony's settings window, and a non-functional toggle macro. The lease is now acquired exactly once (throttled, only when none is held) and is never dropped on a transient error - only when Gluttony itself reports the lease invalid (by then it is already removed, so re-acquiring cannot duplicate).
- Renamed the BossMod combat preset `CBT - DwD` -> `CBT - Gluttony` so the status bar reflects the new combat engine. Preset JSON re-brotli-compressed in `FateGrind._presetCompressed`; `_presetName` updated to match.
- After updating, **reload Gluttony Combo** (or restart the game) once to clear any orphaned duplicate registrations left behind by v0.0.1.40.

v0.0.1.40 - 2026-06-27
- Combat is now driven by **Gluttony Combo** instead of BossMod's "DwD" autorotation. BossMod is kept only for movement and danger avoidance; Gluttony Combo's lease-based Auto-Rotation now owns the combat rotation **and** target selection.
- `FateGrind.HandleIntegrations` enables Gluttony Combo Auto-Rotation on FATE engage via the `GluttonyCombo` IPC (RegisterForLease -> SetAutoRotationState -> SetCurrentJobAutoRotationReady), configured for FATE grinding: DPSRotationMode=Nearest, FATEPriority=on, DPSAlwaysHardTarget=on (so BossMod movement follows Gluttony's hard target), InCombatOnly=off, BypassFATE=on, DPSAoETargets=3.
- BossMod `MiscAI.AutoTarget` now yields target authority to Gluttony: `Retarget=NoTarget` (only auto-targets when the player has nothing targeted) plus `FATE=Enabled` for the bootstrap case. The `MaxTargets` pull cap is retained.
- `FateGrind.DeactivateIntegrations` and the run-stop path disable Gluttony Combo Auto-Rotation so it never fires while travelling between FATEs.
- `Helpers/IPC/GluttonyComboIPC.cs` - IPC subscriber for Gluttony Combo's lease-based Auto-Rotation (prefix `GluttonyCombo`) with lease lifecycle (register/enable/disable/release) and FATE-grinding config. Modeled on GluttonyCombo/docs/IPCExample.cs.
- `Ipc.GluttonyCombo` flag; `Service.Gluttony` instance wired into plugin start/dispose.
- Requires Gluttony Combo installed; the current job's Single-Target + AoE combos are enabled in Auto-Mode automatically. If Gluttony Combo is not loaded, the IsLoaded guard skips the integration and combat falls back to BossMod's prior behavior.
- Version jumped 0.0.1.39 -> 0.0.1.40 (no 0.0.1.39 CHANGELOG entry existed; this entry covers the combat-engine switch).

Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.description:
This plugin detects certain objects/NPCs such as Aether Currents nearby and shows where they are by various ways, e.g. pointing to their locations on screen and notifying you in Chat.

Currently detects:
	- Aether Currents
	- Eureka Elementals (by apetih)
	- Mob Hunt Elite Marks
	- Gathering Points
	- [Experimental] Island Sanctuary Gathering Objects and Animals
	- [Experimental] Quest-related NPCs/Objects 

Note: Because most objects/NPCs are not loaded when they are too faraway or when there are too many entities nearby (such as too many player characters), they will not be detected in this case.

Icon by Lumas Arkfrost

plugin_variants.author: Munn
plugin_variants.changelog:
**Initial release of WukLamark to 'testing/live'**
## What's New
- Create and manage custom waymarks that display visibly on both the Main Map and Minimap.
- Highly customizable markers: Use simple shapes (with custom colors) or pick from hundreds of in-game icons.
- Waymark Groups: Organize your waymarks into nested, collapsible categories.
- Waymark/Group Scopes: Designate waymarks and/or groups as "Personal" (locked to your specific character) or "Shared" (visible to all characters that log in on your PC).
- Read-Only Waymarks/Groups (for Shared Waymarks/Groups): Protect shared waymarks and groups as "Read-Only" so you (or someone else) don't accidentally edit or delete them!
- Import/Export: Easy clipboard sharing to distribute groups of waymarks to your friends.

plugin_variants.author: Jen Hyul
plugin_variants.changelog:
# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection

plugin_variants.author: Rietty
plugin_variants.changelog:
**Shop Item Icons** is a lightweight plugin to display item icons instead of item category icons in shops.

Supported windows:

- **Shops:** Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- **Item Exchange:** Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- **Item Exchange (categorized):** Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- **Currency Exchange:** Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- **Grand Company Seal Exchange:** Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- **Rewards:** Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- **Exchange:** Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.

The plugin has no configuration. It just works.
