plugin_variants.description:
Contributes and utilizes crowdsourced login queue information for the benefit of everyone.

Current features include queue notifications via Discord, so you can know when you make it into the game, as
well as anonymously collecting and reporting statistics about your login queue times to crowdsource information
about FFXIV server load. This information will be publicly available in the future; check the Discord for updates!

Future planned features include login wait time estimates, as well as duty queue time statistics, and a website
showing all of this information.

Discord URL: https://discord.waitingway.com

plugin_variants.author: Infi
plugin_variants.description:
Plugin to help with a number of /random and /dice related games.

Venue Mode:
    + Concise display of all concurrent players in a list-based format
    + Includes functionality for Truth or Dare and Giveaway modes 
    + Support for multiple sorting types (min, max, nearest to) 
    + Highlight numbers based on regex matching 
Death Roll Mode:
    + Support for multiple players
    + Automatically checks for correct number ranges from each player
Tournament Mode:
    + 1 vs 1 Death Roll Tournament
    + Automatic bracket generation
    + Uneven number of players get filled with byes
    + Randomization via shuffling is enforced
    + Forfeit functionality if a player needs to leave

Features:
    + Can block or prevent players from partaking in any of your games 
    + Accepts only /random or /dice commands
    + Ease of removing players from partaking in the concurrent game/tournament

Includes language support for English, German and French FFXIV clients. (Japanese support is planned)
More features are planned for future updates in accordance with feedback.
plugin_variants.name: Death Roll Helper
plugin_variants.punchline: Plugin to help with a number of /random and /dice related games.

plugin_variants.author: Berna
plugin_variants.description:
* Show a Win Panel (with sounds!) when you clear or get wiped in a duty.
* Show a TF2-style timer while in a duty.
* Enable the "Voice Lines" module (via /tfconfig) to have voice lines play when certain conditions are met. What conditions, you ask? It's a surprise! (Unless you uncheck the "Surprise me!" box.)
* More features maybe soon?

Note: This plugin uses files from a local Team Fortress 2 installation.
It'll search for the game's installation folder in all configured Steam Library Folders automatically.

Without a TF2 install, the Timer and Win Panel will work with FF XIV fonts, and no voice line will work.
plugin_variants.name: Team Fortress Fantasy
plugin_variants.punchline:
[REQUIRES TF2 INSTALLED FOR MOST FEATURES] The Mann Brothers just found a deposit of gravel in Eorzea
and hired YOU, Mercenary of Light, to help them FIGHT for it.

plugin_variants.author: Blooym
plugin_variants.description:
Settings Enhanced allows you to create zone-specific system and character configurations; For example, you could lower the amount of rendered players in Limsa, or mute other players sound effects while in stellar crafting zones. Your original configuration data is stored and automatically re-applies when entering an area with you have not created zone setting for, or when disabling the plugin/closing the game.

It is recommended that you create regular backups whilst using this plugin incase something does does break - upon install a check will be ran to see if at least one system/character configuration backup has been created; You will not be able to use the plugin if until you have created one.

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugin_variants.author: Faye, Kage
plugin_variants.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
plugin_variants.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugin_variants.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

plugin_variants.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json
plugin_variants.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugin_variants.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

plugin_variants.description:
Automated character rotation and quest sequence execution for Questionable.

Automates multi-character MSQ progression by intelligently switching between characters based on quest completion and level requirements. Features include:
- Automatic character switching and quest tracking
- MSQ progression monitoring across all characters
- Allied Society quest rotation and prioritization
- Event quest automation with prerequisite checking
- Chauffeur Mode for following main character through quests
- Data Center travel automation
- Stop point configuration for controlled progression

Required Plugins: Questionable, AutoRetainer

plugin_variants.punchline: Automated character rotation and quest sequence execution
